programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.desc: In this special episode of Deadly 60, Steve Backshall takes a deep dive into the fate of one of the most extraordinary, and endangered, ecosystems on our planet: coral reefs. They may cover less than one per cent of the ocean floor, but they support roughly a quarter of all marine life and are irreplaceable - yet they are in serious trouble. Steve travels to some of the world’s most celebrated reef systems, from the shallows of the Java Sea to the tropical waters of the Maldives. Along the way, he meets all the weird and wonderful creatures that call the reef home, including some of the best-camouflaged creatures and some impressive apex predators - he even gets a telling-off from a clownfish.

Steve Backshall comes face-to-face with these apex predators off the coast of Mexico, and reveals it’s not just the ocean that they hunt in; they can also move into freshwater rivers and lakes, and have been found thousands of kilometres up the Amazon River. Back in Steve’s Shark Lab, he reveals how the bull shark adapts do the varying salt levels using its very clever kidneys.

programme.title: Death in Paradise
programme.desc: Marlon receives a mysterious phone call from his old boss, who sounds badly injured as he begs him for help. It’s a blast from his criminal past, and someone he’s not spoken to since joining the police force. When Marlon hurries over, he’s horrified to find his former boss dead – having been shot. And the only witness is a parrot... Marlon’s determined to solve the case, insistent that – although his former boss dabbled in criminality – he wasn’t a bad guy. But when the team uncover two potential suspects, they’re frustrated to find themselves at a stalemate. Whilst one suspect has every opportunity but absolutely no motive, the other has every motive but a rock-solid alibi.

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: Janie is tasked with solving the murder of divisive best man Gethin Bennion the night before a wedding. What initially seems to be a burglary gone wrong quickly unravels complicated family dynamics and betrayed friendships, revealing just how far people will go for love. Janie is forced to face up to her personal experience of a friendship turned sour in order to connect with a suspect and crack the case. Meanwhile, John forms an unlikely connection with one of the suspects over art and painting, forcing him to re-evaluate the role that work played in his own marriage and the circumstances around his late wife’s passing.

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: Following the murder of coastal town businesswoman and am-dram theatre director Menna Hughes, Janie is eager to solve the case and land the DI promotion she desperately wants. She enlists John’s help, but bristling at Janie’s insinuation that he might have ‘lost’ his acting chops, John takes matters into his own hands and joins the cast of the theatre group’s next play. What starts out as a murder investigation soon becomes a cathartic journey for John, who is unexpectedly reminded of why he fell in love with acting in the first place. As for Janie, witnessing a downtrodden suspect finally stand up for themselves inspires her to confront her own demons from the past.

programme.title: The Beauty Queen and the Catfish
programme.desc: Dr David’s victims begin comparing their stories, and it becomes clear they are dealing with a sophisticated catfish. But nothing could prepare them for the shocking truth of the perpetrator’s true identity, which leaves the women with more questions than answers. But when beauty queen Abbie takes these findings to the police, they are unable to do anything about it, and the Catfish of Kilmarnock remains free to target more and more victims. Abbie can’t walk away, and steps up her investigation over months that turn into years. As she continues to track the catfish, the scale of their criminality comes into focus, with victims spread across the country and dating back over a decade. This is one of the UK’s most prolific ever catfish, and they are not done yet.

programme.title: The Beauty Queen and the Catfish
programme.desc: As criminal investigations take hold, the victims finally have justice, but they are still left urgently searching for answers as they try to rebuild their lives. What drives someone, with a seemingly normal life, to throw it all away to terrorise countless women from the same town? With no clear motive and no explanation from the person in the frame, this very modern true crime tale now turns to those closest to the perpetrator, who are also trying to understand the mystery behind the repeated cycles of offending. As the beauty queen and the catfish’s lives become ever more entangled, lines begin to blur, loyalties are tested, and Abbie finds herself questioning everything as history repeats, and the moral complexity of crime and punishment in the internet age is laid bare. For the many victims, the question remains: what drives someone to become one of the UK’s most prolific catfish - and why can’t they stop.

programme.desc: Informativo deportivo que se hace eco de las competiciones, resultados, aficiones y demás noticias destacadas del mundo del deporte.

programme.title: Avant après
programme.desc: Le Quartier des spectacles, aujourd'hui le coeur culturel de Montréal, est depuis longtemps associé au côté festif de la ville; c'est dans ce secteur animé que se trouvait ce que l'on appelait le Red Light, dont l'origine remonte au 19e siècle.

programme.title: Les prix Acfas 2025
programme.desc: Professeur émérite au Département des arts, langues et littératures de l'Université de Sherbrooke, Pierre Hébert est le lauréat 2025 du prix Acfas André-Laurendeau pour les sciences humaines, lettres et arts. Parrainé par le ministère de la Langue française du Québec.

programme.title: Montréal sauvage
programme.desc: On lève le voile sur la vie secrète d'animaux rares et méconnus qui se cachent dans les derniers espaces sauvages restants sur l'île de Montréal, habitée par plus de deux millions d'humains.

programme.title: Condensé de science
programme.desc: Les galaxies sont des amas gigantesques d'étoiles, de planètes et de nébuleuses. On estime qu'il y a des milliards de milliards de galaxies et certaines sont presque aussi vieilles que l'Univers, soit environ 13,8 milliards d'années. Et parmi ces galaxies, la plupart sont de forme elliptique ou en forme de spirale, comme notre Voie lactée.

programme.title: Adonis
programme.desc: Dans l'indifférence générale, une crise de santé publique se joue: de plus en plus de jeunes hommes consomment des stéroïdes anabolisants afin d'obtenir le corps de leurs rêves.

programme.title: Condensé de science
programme.desc: Les planètes se forment dans la foulée de la formation de leur étoile. Dans notre système solaire, tout a commencé il y a 4,5 milliards d'années. Une diversité incroyable de protoplanètes s'est formée autour de notre Soleil, c'est-à-dire les huit planètes composant notre système solaire: Mercure, Vénus, Terre, Mars, Jupiter, Saturne, Uranus et Neptune.

programme.title: La disparition tranquille
programme.desc: Au Québec, la situation du français est fragile et on se pose des questions sur son avenir. La réalisatrice Flavie Payette-Renouf essaie de comprendre ce qui menace vraiment notre langue, alors que l'anglais est de plus en plus attractif et de plus en plus utilisé.

programme.title: Petits curieux, grands écrans
programme.desc: La gestion des écrans est une responsabilité collective impliquant parents, garderies, écoles et gouvernements; les enfants imitent les adultes, donc notre propre utilisation des écrans est importante.

programme.title: Hallucinant!
programme.desc: On explore les effets du cannabis sur les récepteurs du cerveau qui sont responsables de différentes sensations et émotions.

programme.title: Justice et châtiments
programme.desc: De l'Antiquité aux débats actuels, cet épisode retrace la manière dont les sociétés ont successivement toléré, condamné puis redéfini la diversité sexuelle et de genre. Des accusations de sodomie aux bûchers médiévaux, des persécutions nazies aux descentes policières dans les bars gais, l'Histoire révèle un long usage du droit pour exclure.

programme.title: Autour d'une oeuvre
programme.desc: On reçoit Guy Laforest pour une immersion dans l'histoire politique du Québec, de 1763 au référendum de 1995; entre archives, anecdotes et jeux se dessine le portrait d'un intellectuel engagé, universitaire et politologue.

programme.title: Parlons job
programme.desc: Pendant des décennies, les problèmes de santé mentale au travail étaient tabous, jusqu'à ce que l'on constate les coûts faramineux qu'ils entraînaient.

programme.title: Petits curieux, grands écrans
programme.desc: Les écrans peuvent nuire au développement du langage et de la communication chez les tout-petits; ils isolent l'enfant, le privant d'interactions essentielles avec ses parents, nécessaires au développement de ses habiletés langagières.

programme.title: La clinique des mots
programme.desc: Si une femme est enceinte, elle sera suivie par un médecin en gynécologie-obstétrique ou par une sage-femme; lors de ses rendez-vous, on lui parlera peut-être d'épidurale, de dure-mère ou de césarienne; on demande d'où viennent ces mots.

programme.title: Naissances du futur
programme.desc: La cryoconservation des ovules, initialement conçue pour préserver la fertilité des patientes atteintes de maladies graves, est désormais utilisée pour repousser la maternité de quelques années; cette avancée promet liberté et contrôle, mais soulève des questions sur son efficacité réelle, son coût élevé et son encadrement éthique; entre progrès médical et logique commerciale, on s'interroge sur la transformation de la fertilité en un bien à conserver.

programme.title: La guerre des cerveaux
programme.desc: Raed Hammoud décrypte la guerre cognitive, un nouveau type de conflit où le cerveau humain devient le champ de bataille. À l'aide d'expert.e.s, il retrace son évolution, de la propagande traditionnelle aux stratégies modernes fondées sur les réseaux sociaux, les données et l'intelligence artificielle. Des exemples comme le Brexit et l'élection de Trump montrent comment la désinformation, l'ingérence étrangère et la manipulation émotionnelle fragilisent les démocraties,...

programme.title: La clinique des mots
programme.desc: Les reins filtrent le sang pour éliminer les déchets et produisent l'urine; quand ils fonctionnent moins bien, on consulte en néphrologie.

programme.title: De la scie au bistouri
programme.desc: On parcourt toutes les expérimentations qui ont permis qu'aujourd'hui, on traite l'incontinence, les infections urinaires et les malformations des appareils génitaux; on découvre aussi l'urologie de l'avenir.

programme.title: Mission : guérir
programme.desc: Des patients gravement blessés sont en traitement dans un centre de réadaptation de Longueuil. On est témoin du travail constant d'une physiothérapeute et d'une ergothérapeute pour les aider à reprendre leurs activités quotidiennes. On suit également un technicien en orthèse-prothèse dans son atelier et en interaction avec un patient. Chez chacune de ces personnes, on sent la compétence, la passion et un désir sincère d'aider les autres.

programme.title: Générations sous pression
programme.desc: Exploration des défis psychologiques propres à chaque âge de la vie. À travers témoignages, analyses et récits intimes, la série brosse le portrait d'une société dans laquelle chaque génération affronte ses propres formes de pression et de fragilité.

programme.title: De garde 24/7
programme.desc: Le parcours des patients peut être marqué par différentes fins: celle d'un traitement, de la maladie ou de la vie.

programme.title: Condensé de science
programme.desc: Les sorties spatiales sont loin d'être des promenades de santé. À l'extérieur de la navette, les astronautes font face à un environnement hostile. Chaque sortie comporte des dangers. Il y a des risques de collision avec les débris qui flottent dans l'espace ou encore une fuite du système de ventilation de la combinaison. Et pourtant, la plupart des astronautes considèrent ces sorties dans l'espace comme une incroyable expérience.

programme.title: Parlons job
programme.desc: En 1907, le pont de Québec s'effondre, causant la mort de 76 ouvriers ; perchés à des dizaines de mètres de hauteur, ces derniers n'avaient aucun équipement de sécurité pour se protéger.

programme.title: Les lieux de pouvoir au Québec
programme.desc: Le bunker est un édifice mal-aimé à cause de son architecture brutaliste. C'est là que se sont déroulés tous les Conseils des ministres de Robert Bourassa à Bernard Landry et que se trouvait le bureau du premier ministre à la même période. Aujourd'hui, les négociations entre le secteur public et le gouvernement ont généralement lieu au rez-de-chaussée. Martine Tremblay nous raconte les dessous de la fin du mandat de René Lévesque, dont elle était cheffe de cabinet.

programme.title: Condensé de science
programme.desc: Dans notre voisinage céleste, il y a une foule d'objets qu'on peine parfois à définir. Parmi tous ces genres de cailloux qui animent notre système solaire, comment distinguer une comète d'un astéroïde ? Et quelle est la différence entre un météore, un météoroïde et une météorite ? Ils ont toutefois quelque chose en commun : tous pourraient atterrir sur notre planète !

programme.title: Objectif Laurentie
programme.desc: La beauté des paysages dans les photographies de Pierre Lahoud révèle son sentiment d'appartenance et sa connexion avec le territoire; direction Rivière-Ouelle: la première ville québécoise ayant obtenu le statut de paysage culturel patrimonial.

programme.title: La clinique des mots
programme.desc: On découvre le vocabulaire utilisé pour décrire les personnes atteintes de maladie mentale.

programme.desc: Alors que les derniers survivants de l'Holocauste s'apprêtent à quitter ce monde, on s'interroge avec le psychiatre Patrick Bordeaux sur la manière dont on peut préserver et transmettre cette mémoire pour les générations futures.

programme.desc: On connait leurs noms, mais peu les exploits de Jeanne Mance et Émilie Gamelin; ces pionnières infatigables ont contribué à créer le premier filet social du Québec; Valérie Plante suit leurs traces.

programme.title: Condensé de science

programme.title: Dehors, l'école!
programme.desc: L'anxiété est plus présente qu'avant chez les jeunes et la surexposition aux écrans y joue un rôle; l'école en plein air peut contrer ce phénomène en reconnectant les jeunes à la nature et en favorisant les interactions sociales; à l'École secondaire Monseigneur-Richard, à Verdun, les élèves sont initiés à la pêche au brochet; on assiste à un cours de science exaltant, en extérieur, à l'École secondaire de l'Odyssée, à Valcourt.

programme.title: Condensé de science

programme.title: Jurassic World
programme.desc: Located off the coast of Costa Rica, the Jurassic World luxury resort provides a habitat for an array of genetically engineered dinosaurs, including the vicious and intelligent Indominus rex. When the massive creature escapes, it sets off a chain reaction that causes the other dinos to run amok. Now, it's up to a former military man and animal expert (Chris Pratt) to use his special skills to save two young brothers and the rest of the tourists from an all-out, prehistoric assault.

programme.title: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: In Steven Spielberg's massive blockbuster, paleontologists Alan Grant (Sam Neill) and Ellie Sattler (Laura Dern) and mathematician Ian Malcolm (Jeff Goldblum) are among a select group chosen to tour an island theme park populated by dinosaurs created from prehistoric DNA. While the park's mastermind, billionaire John Hammond (Richard Attenborough), assures everyone that the facility is safe, they find out otherwise when various ferocious predators break free and go on the hunt.

programme.title: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: Four years after "Jurassic Park," mathematician Ian Malcolm ventures onto a second island to save his girlfriend from becoming dinosaur bait.

programme.title: Jurassic Park III
programme.desc: After being persuaded by a wealthy businessman to conduct an aerial tour of Isla Sorna, InGen's second site for a failed Jurassic Park experiment, Dr. Alan Grant discovers the true reason for his invitation. A tragic accident maroons the party of seven, and they must attempt to escape with their lives.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Based on the popular Tom Clancy novel, this suspenseful movie tracks Soviet submarine captain Marko Ramius as he abandons his orders and heads for the east coast of the United States. Equipped with innovative stealth technology, Ramius' submarine, "Red October," is virtually invisible. However, when an American sub briefly detects the Russians' presence, CIA agent Jack Ryan sets out to determine Ramius' motives, fearing he may launch an attack on the U.S.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: Set in 1973, it chronicles the funny and often poignant coming of age of 15-year-old William, an unabashed music fan who is inspired by the seminal bands of the time. When his love of music lands him an assignment from Rolling Stone Magazine to interview the up-and-coming band Stillwater -- fronted by lead guitar Russell Hammond and lead singer Jeff Bebe, William embarks on an eye-opening journey with the band's tour, despite the objections of his protective mother.

programme.title: Harold & Kumar Go to White Castle
programme.desc: Nerdy accountant Harold (John Cho) and his irrepressible friend, Kumar (Kal Penn), get stoned watching television and find themselves utterly bewitched by a commercial for White Castle. Convinced there must be one nearby, the two set out on a late-night odyssey that takes them deep into New Jersey. Somehow, the boys manage to run afoul of rednecks, cops and even a car-stealing Neil Patrick Harris before getting anywhere near their beloved sliders.

programme.title: The Back-up Plan
programme.desc: Tired of waiting for Mr. Right while her biological clock ticks away, Zoe (Jennifer Lopez) decides it's time to make an appointment at the sperm bank. On the same day as her procedure, she meets Stan (Alex O'Loughlin), a man with the potential to be her ideal mate. When Stan learns that Zoe's unpredictable behavior is the result of her pregnancy, he declares his commitment. As the due date approaches, both lovers realize that they really don't know each other without a baby in the picture.

programme.title: The Guilt Trip
programme.desc: Before embarking on a once-in-a-lifetime road trip, Andy Brewster pays a visit to his overbearing mother, Joyce. That proves to be a big mistake; Andy caves in under pressure to take his mom along for the ride. Early on -- as the miles roll by -- Andy feels nothing but aggravation at her antics. Eventually however, he comes to realize that they have more in common than he first thought and that Joyce's wisdom might be just what he needs.

programme.title: A Bad Moms Christmas
programme.desc: Under-appreciated and overburdened moms Amy, Kiki and Carla rebel against the challenges and expectations of the Super Bowl for moms: Christmas. As if creating the perfect holiday for their families isn't hard enough, they'll have to do it while hosting and entertaining their own respective mothers when they come to visit.

programme.title: The Edge of Seventeen
programme.desc: Everyone knows that growing up is hard, and life is no easier for high school junior Nadine (Hailee Steinfeld), who is already at peak awkwardness when her all-star older brother Darian (Blake Jenner) starts dating her best friend Krista (Haley Lu Richardson). All at once, Nadine feels more alone than ever, until an unexpected friendship with a thoughtful teen (Hayden Szeto) gives her a glimmer of hope that things just might not be so terrible after all.

programme.title: The Terminal
programme.desc: When Viktor Navorski (Tom Hanks), an Eastern European tourist, arrives at JFK in New York, war breaks out in his country, and he finds himself caught up in international politics. Because of the war, the Department of Homeland Security won't let him enter or exit the United States. He's trapped at JFK -- indefinitely. While living at the airport, Viktor falls for a flight attendant (Catherine Zeta-Jones). She may have feelings for him too. But what good is love if Viktor can't leave the terminal?

programme.title: The Aviator
programme.desc: Billionaire and aviation tycoon Howard Hughes (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a successful public figure: a director of big-budget Hollywood films such as "Hell's Angels," a passionate lover of Hollywood leading ladies Katharine Hepburn (Cate Blanchett) and Ava Gardner (Kate Beckinsale), and an aviation pioneer who helps build TWA into a major airline. But in private, Hughes remains tormented, suffering from paralyzing phobias and depression. The higher he rises, the farther has to fall.

programme.title: Enemy at the Gates
programme.desc: Vassili is a young Russian sharpshooter who becomes a legend when a savvy political officer makes him the hero of his propaganda campaign. Their friendship is threatened when both men fall in love with a beautiful female soldier. As the battle for the city rages, Vassili faces the ultimate challenge when the Nazi command dispatches its most elite marksman to hunt down and kill the man who has become the hope of all Russia.

programme.title: Lara Croft Tomb Raider: The Cradle of Life
programme.desc: Fearless explorer Lara Croft (Angelina Jolie) tries to locate Pandora's box before criminals Jonathan Reiss (Ciarán Hinds) and Chen Lo (Simon Yam) use it for evil. According to myth, the box holds deadly organisms that could kill millions of people. With her old partner, Terry (Gerard Butler), Croft goes on a hunt that takes her from Europe to Asia to Africa, where pal Kosa (Djimon Hounsou) helps her. Along the way, Croft rappels down cliffs, scuba dives and decimates many male opponents.

programme.title: Million Dollar Baby
programme.desc: Frankie Dunn (Clint Eastwood) is a veteran Los Angeles boxing trainer who keeps almost everyone at arm's length, except his old friend and associate Eddie "Scrap Iron" Dupree (Morgan Freeman). When Maggie Fitzgerald (Hilary Swank) arrives in Frankie's gym seeking his expertise, he is reluctant to train the young woman, a transplant from working-class Missouri. Eventually, he relents, and the two form a close bond that will irrevocably change them both.

programme.title: Wolves
programme.desc: Anthony is a standout player on his Manhattan high school's basketball team with seemingly everything going for him: a killer three-point shot, a loving girlfriend, and a chance at a scholarship to Cornell. But Anthony's dreams of playing college ball are jeopardized by his volatile father, a hard-drinking writer whose compulsive gambling threatens to derail the lives of both his wife and son.

programme.title: Downhill Racer
programme.desc: A smug and overly self-assured downhill skier, David Chappellet (Robert Redford), joins the American ski team and quickly makes waves with his arrogant behavior and even flashier maneuvers on the slopes, falling into conflict with the team's coach (Gene Hackman). A rivalry also develops between David and Johnny Creech (Jim McMullan), the man who considered the team's best skier, as both push themselves and each other in a race to the Olympic Games.

programme.title: Cheech & Chong's Last Movie
programme.desc: Cheech Marin and Tommy Chong discuss their lifelong friendship and popularity as a comedic duo. Features interviews, sketches and never-before-seen footage spanning their five-decade career.

programme.title: Supercop
programme.desc: To infiltrate a drug cartel, police Inspector Chan Ka Kui (Jackie Chan) goes undercover in a Chinese prison. There, he earns the trust of Panther (Yuen Wah), a cartel member, by breaking him out of prison. With the help of another undercover agent (Michelle Yeaoh), they travel to Hong Kong and join up with Panther's gang. Ka Kui is accepted by the gang's leader (Ken Tsang), but his operation is jeopardized when Ka Kui's girlfriend (Maggie Cheung) accidentally reveals his true identity.

programme.title: V for Vengeance
programme.desc: After learning that their younger sibling escaped an earlier kidnapping attempt that also killed their parents, two estranged sisters must join forces to rescue her from a group of bloodthirsty vampires. Out for revenge and control of a vampirism vaccine, Thorn and his band of the undead soon learn that they messed with the wrong family.

programme.title: The Contractor
programme.desc: Involuntarily discharged from the Army, a special forces sergeant lands a contract with a private underground military force. When his very first assignment goes awry, the elite soldier finds himself hunted and on the run, caught in a dangerous conspiracy and fighting to stay alive long enough to get home and uncover the true motives of those who betrayed him.

programme.title: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: The four nations of Air, Water, Earth and Fire lived in harmony until the Fire Nation declared war. A century later, there is still no end in sight to the destruction, then, an Avatar named Aang (Noah Ringer) discovers that he has the power to control the four elements. He joins forces with Katara (Nicola Peltz), a Waterbender, and her brother, Sokka, to restore balance and harmony to their world.

programme.title: Harriet the Spy
programme.desc: Harriet (Michelle Trachtenberg) may only be in the sixth grade, but she's already found her calling: to be a spy. In a private journal she takes everywhere, Harriet records suspicious activity and keeps a running list of observations on virtually everyone she knows. It seems harmless enough until, one day, someone finds the journal and exposes Harriet's critical thoughts about her classmates. Suddenly, even her best friends are against her, and Harriet resolves to take revenge.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Dr. Indiana Jones, a renowned archeologist and expert in the occult, is hired by the U.S. Government to find the ark of the covenant, which is believed to still hold the Ten Commandments. Unfortunately, Hitler's agents are also after the ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion escape from various close scrapes in a quest that takes them from Nepal to Cairo.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: The second of the Lucas/Spielberg Indiana Jones epics is set a year or so before the events in Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy needs to retrieve a precious gem and several kidnapped young boys on behalf of a remote East Indian village. This time he teams up with a night club singer and a 12-year old boy.

programme.title: Top Gun: Maverick
programme.desc: After more than 30 years of service as one of the Navy's top aviators, Pete "Maverick" Mitchell is where he belongs, pushing the envelope as a courageous test pilot and dodging the advancement in rank that would ground him. Training a detachment of graduates for a special assignment, Maverick must confront the ghosts of his past and his deepest fears, culminating in a mission that demands the ultimate sacrifice from those who choose to fly it.

programme.title: Seabiscuit
programme.desc: In the midst of the Great Depression, a businessman (Jeff Bridges) coping with the tragic death of his son, a jockey with a history of brutal injuries (Tobey Maguire) and a down-and-out horse trainer (Chris Cooper) team up to help Seabiscuit, a temperamental, undersized racehorse. At first the horse struggles to win, but eventually Seabiscuit becomes one of the most successful thoroughbreds of all time, and inspires a nation at a time when it needs it most.

programme.title: Heist 88
programme.desc: A criminal mastermind decides to pull one last job before going to prison and recruits a group of young bank employees to steal millions in a daring and brazen assault on the U.S. banking system.

programme.title: An Unfinished Life
programme.desc: Einar (Robert Redford), a recovering alcoholic rancher who lives with his loyal pal Mitch (Morgan Freeman), gets an unexpected visit from his daughter-in-law, Jean (Jennifer Lopez), and granddaughter, Griff (Becca Gardner). Einar holds a grudge against Jean because he feels she's responsible for his son's accidental death, but he reluctantly lets her stay at the farm when he learns that she's trapped in a violent relationship. Over time, they grow closer and try to heal their emotional wounds.

programme.title: I, Daniel Blake
programme.desc: Daniel Blake (Dave Johns) is a 59-year-old widowed carpenter who must rely on welfare after a recent heart attack leaves him unable to work. Despite his doctor's diagnosis, British authorities deny Blake's benefits and tell him to return to his job. As Daniel navigates his way through an agonizing appeal process, he begins to develop a strong bond with a destitute, single mother (Hayley Squires) who's struggling to take care of her two children.

programme.title: Cool World
programme.desc: After a bizarre incident, Frank Harris is transported into the cartoon realm of Cool World, where he remains the only human among various animated characters for years. Eventually, artist Jack Deebs also enters Cool World and sets his lustful sights on his own creation, a blond bombshell named Holli Would. However, excessive intermingling between cartoons and humans is said to lead to dire consequences, a risk Jack seems ready to take.

programme.title: Jenny's Wedding
programme.desc: When Jenny (Katherine Heigl) decides to marry a woman (Alexis Bledel), her conventional family must accept who she is or risk losing her forever.

programme.title: Election
programme.desc: Jim McAllister (Matthew Broderick), a well-liked high school government teacher, can't help but notice that successful student Tracy Flick (Reese Witherspoon) uses less than ethical tactics to get what she wants. When Tracy runs for school president, Jim feels that she will be a poor influence on the student body and convinces Paul, a dim-witted but popular student athlete, to run against Tracy. When she becomes aware of Jim's secret involvement in the race, a bitter feud is sparked.

programme.title: Dinner for Schmucks
programme.desc: Tim (Paul Rudd) a rising executive, works for a boss who hosts a monthly event in which the guest who brings the biggest buffoon gets a career boost. Though he declines the invitation at first, he changes his mind when he meets Barry (Steve Carell), a man who builds dioramas using stuffed mice. The scheme backfires when Barry's blundering good intentions send Tim's life into a downward spiral, threatening a major business deal and possibly scuttling Tim's romantic relationship.

programme.title: Run & Gun
programme.desc: After leaving a life of crime and violence, reformed good guy Ray enjoys a quiet family life in the suburbs. However, Ray's past comes back to haunt him as he gets blackmailed into one last job to collect a mysterious package. After a deadly double-cross, he soon finds himself wounded and on the run from ruthless assassins who will stop at nothing to get what he has.

programme.title: Not Without Hope
programme.desc: Four friends face disaster when their boat capsizes in the Gulf of Mexico. Battling massive waves, sharks, dehydration and hypothermia, they cling to hope as Capt. Timothy Close and his Coast Guard crew launch a daring rescue through a raging storm to save them.

programme.title: Primal Fear
programme.desc: Defense attorney Martin Vail takes on jobs for money and prestige rather than any sense of the greater good. His latest case involves an altar boy, accused of brutally murdering the archbishop of Chicago. Vail finds himself up against his ex-pupil and ex-lover, but as the case progresses and the Church's dark secrets are revealed, Vail finds that what appeared a simple case takes on a darker, more dangerous aspect.

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: In this sequel set eleven years after "The Terminator," young John Connor (Edward Furlong), the key to civilization's victory over a future robot uprising, is the target of the shape-shifting T-1000 (Robert Patrick), a Terminator sent from the future to kill him. Another Terminator, the revamped T-800 (Arnold Schwarzenegger), has been sent back to protect the boy. As John and his mother (Linda Hamilton) go on the run with the T-800, the boy forms an unexpected bond with the robot.

programme.title: No Country for Old Men
programme.desc: While out hunting, Llewelyn Moss (Josh Brolin) finds the grisly aftermath of a drug deal. Though he knows better, he cannot resist the cash left behind and takes it with him. The hunter becomes the hunted when a merciless killer named Chigurh (Javier Bardem) picks up his trail. Also looking for Moss is Sheriff Bell (Tommy Lee Jones), an aging lawman who reflects on a changing world and a dark secret of his own, as he tries to find and protect Moss.

programme.title: The Friend
programme.desc: New York City writer Iris finds her comfortable, solitary life thrown into disarray after her closest friend and mentor bequeaths her a Great Dane named Apollo. The huge dog immediately creates practical problems for Iris, from furniture destruction to eviction notices, as well as more existential ones. Yet as Iris finds herself unexpectedly bonding with Apollo, she begins to come to terms with her past, and her own creative inner life.

programme.title: Waking Up in Reno
programme.desc: Candy (Charlize Theron) and Lonnie Earl (Billy Bob Thornton) are just crazy about each other. The problem: she's married to Roy (Patrick Swayze) and he's married to Darlene (Natasha Richardson). So far it's been a secret affair. But that's about to change, because this foursome is driving cross-country and headed for some big surprises.

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Diary
programme.desc: At the start of the New Year, 32-year-old Bridget (Renée Zellweger) decides it's time to take control of her life -- and start keeping a diary. Now, the most provocative, erotic and hysterical book on her bedside table is the one she's writing. With a taste for adventure, and an opinion on every subject - from exercise to men to food to sex and everything in between - she's turning the page on a whole new life.

programme.title: Abandon
programme.desc: A psychological thriller about a senior (Katie Holmes) at one of America's most prestigious universities. Under enormous pressure to complete her thesis and earn a top job at one of the world's most competitive consulting firms, Katie is still coping with the sudden unexplained disappearance of her first love two years prior. As the investigation continues, Katie is forced to choose between past passions and new possibilities, even as new facts are uncovered.

programme.title: Monstrous
programme.desc: A terrifying new horror awaits Laura and her 7-year-old son, Cody, when then they flee her abusive ex-husband and try to settle into a new life in an idyllic and remote lakeside farmhouse. Still traumatized, their physical and mental well-being are pushed to the limit as their fragile existence is threatened.

programme.title: The Woman in Black
programme.desc: Arthur Kipps, a lawyer, is recently widowed and grieving the loss of his wife when he is sent to a remote village to put a deceased eccentric's affairs in order. Soon after his arrival, it becomes clear that the villagers are hiding a terrible secret. Kipps discovers that his late client's house is haunted by the spirit of a woman who is trying to find someone and something she lost, and that no one -- not even the children -- is safe from her terrible wrath.

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody...

programme.title: The Resurgence: DeMarcus Cousins
programme.desc: A documentary following DeMarcus Cousins while he recovers from an injury that has been a career death sentence for some NBA players; featuring exclusive interviews with teammates, coaches and NBA insiders.

programme.title: Things We Lost in the Fire

Nearly paralyzed by grief, Audrey tracks down her husband's childhood friend, Jerry (Benicio del Toro). Jerry is a drug addict, but Audrey invites him to move into her home nevertheless, and a mutually dependent relationship develops between the two damaged souls.

programme.title: Losing Isaiah
programme.desc: Khaila Richards (Halle Berry), a crack-addicted single mother, accidentally leaves her baby in a dumpster while high and returns the next day in a panic to find he is missing. In reality, the baby has been adopted by a warm-hearted social worker, Margaret Lewin (Jessica Lange), and her husband, Charles (David Strathairn). Years later, Khaila has gone through rehab and holds a steady job. After learning that her child is still alive, she challenges Margaret for the custody.

programme.title: The Boy in the Striped Pajamas
programme.desc: During World War II, 8-year-old Bruno (Asa Butterfield) and his family leave Berlin to take up residence near the concentration camp where his father (David Thewlis) has just become commandant. Unhappy and lonely, he wanders out behind his house one day and finds Shmuel (Jack Scanlon), a Jewish boy of his age. Though the barbed-wire fence of the camp separates them, the boys begin a forbidden friendship, oblivious to the real nature of their surroundings.

programme.title: The Sons of Katie Elder
programme.desc: Four ne'er-do-well sons reunite in their Texas hometown to attend their mother's funeral. Led by older brothers John (John Wayne), a gunfighter, and Tom (Dean Martin), a gambler, the four soon learn that their father gambled away the family ranch, which was the cause of his murder. The brothers decide to avenge their father's death and win back the ranch, a situation that quickly leads to trouble with the local sheriff and violent conflict with the rival Hastings clan.

programme.title: Stockholm
programme.desc: After taking hostages in a Stockholm bank, ex-con Lars Nystrom demands the release of his old partner in crime from prison. As the situation escalates, Lars starts to let down his guard as he develops an uneasy bond with one of the female employees.

programme.title: Mille secrets, mille dangers
programme.desc: Alain se marie avec Virginie. La journée sera grandiose, la journée sera parfaite et les tantes libanaises d'Alain parleront de cette noce pour des années à venir. Cependant, Alain a mal au ventre. Une colère sourde gronde en lui. Il craint les retrouvailles de ses parents dont le divorce orageux a troublé son enfance. Il craint le retour en force de ses crises d'anxiété, il craint sa dépendance aux médicaments dans laquelle il est sur le point de retomber.

programme.title: Mlle Bottine
programme.desc: Philippe, un compositeur d'opéra en panne d'inspiration, se voit forcé d'héberger sa nièce Simone, une orpheline rebelle et excentrique dont la meilleure amie est une moufette ; malgré leurs personnalités diamétralement opposées, Philippe et Simone découvrent rapidement qu'ils pourraient avoir besoin l'un de l'autre plus qu'ils ne l'auraient initialement cru.

programme.title: Le train
programme.desc: Agathe, une enfant asthmatique, vit avec sa mère Thérèse, une artiste mélancolique. La nuit, le sifflement d'un train alimente sa vision d'un monde parallèle où transitent des voyageurs venus du futur. Adolescente, Agathe rencontre Frank, un jeune écrivain qui lui permet de franchir la frontière entre le présent et le futur.

programme.title: Bad romance: l'histoire de Vicky White
programme.desc: Vicky White, agente correctionnelle, développe en secret une obsession pour le détenu Casey White. Devant son transfert imminent, elle risque tout pour le faire évader, déclenchant une vaste chasse à l'homme à travers le pays.

programme.title: Seule au front
programme.desc: En 1996, après un exercice dans le cadre de la formation obligatoire, la capitaine de l'armée canadienne Sandra Perron met fin à sa carrière militaire. Sa décision prend une tournure politique alors qu'elle surprend plusieurs officiers supérieurs et qu'une enquête dévoile les raisons de son départ.

programme.title: Les quatre fabuleuses
programme.desc: Des amies de longue date se rendent à Key West, en Floride, pour être demoiselles d'honneur au mariage surprise d'une amie d'université. Au cours d'une excursion rocambolesque, les liens entre soeurs se renouent, le passé refait surface et il y a suffisamment d'étincelles, de sexe et de romance pour changer la vie de chacune de manière inattendue.

programme.title: O'Dessa
programme.desc: Dans un futur post-apocalyptique, une jeune fermière part à la quête d'un héritage familial précieux. Son voyage la mène dans une ville étrange et dangereuse, où elle rencontre son grand amour. Pour sauver son âme, elle devra défier le destin et mettre le pouvoir de la musique à rude épreuve.

programme.title: Harry Potter et la chambre des secrets
programme.desc: Alors que l'oncle Vernon, la tante Pétunia et son cousin Dudley reçoivent d'importants invités à dîner, Harry Potter est contraint de passer la soirée dans sa chambre. Dobby, un elfe, fait alors son apparition. Il lui annonce que de terribles dangers menacent l'école de Poudlard et qu'il ne doit pas y retourner en septembre. Harry refuse de le croire. Mais sitôt la rentrée des classes effectuée, ce dernier entend une voix malveillante.

programme.title: Harry Potter et le prisonnier d'Azkaban
programme.desc: Sirius Black, un dangereux sorcier criminel, s'échappe de la sombre prison d'Azkaban avec un seul et unique but : retrouver Harry Potter, en troisième année à l'école de Poudlard. Le jeune sorcier et ses amis vont devoir faire face à Sirius Black, ce fugitif qui est lié au passé de Harry.

programme.title: Harry Potter et la coupe de feu
programme.desc: La quatrième année à l'école de Poudlard est marquée par le Tournoi des trois sorciers. Les participants sont choisis par la fameuse coupe de feu, qui est à l'origine d'un scandale. Elle sélectionne Harry Potter tandis qu'il n'a pas l'âge légal requis. Après avoir surmonté une série d'épreuves physiques de plus en plus difficiles, il est enfin confronté à Celui-Dont-On-Ne-Doit-Pas-Prononcer-Le-Nom.

programme.title: Harry Potter et l'Ordre du Phénix
programme.desc: À sa cinquième année à l'école de sorcellerie de Poudlard, Harry Potter passe pour un illuminé, le ministre de la magie Cornelius Fudge ayant officiellement réfuté les révélations de l'adolescent et de son directeur, Dumbledore, disant que le terrifiant Lord Voldemort est de retour. Une nouvelle professeure à Poudlard refuse d'enseigner les techniques défensives magiques, et Harry crée donc un groupe de résistance clandestin, surnommé l'armée de Dumbledore, à l'image de l'Ordre du Phénix.

programme.title: Bâtiment 5
programme.desc: Une militante et un jeune maire s'affrontent au sujet de la meilleure voie à suivre pour aider leur quartier défavorisé.

programme.title: Un beau grand voyage audacieux
programme.desc: Sarah et David, deux célibataires inconnus, se rencontrent au mariage d'un ami commun et, par un surprenant coup du sort, se retrouvent embarqués dans un voyage grandiose et audacieux : une aventure drôle, fantastique et palpitante où ils revivent des moments importants de leur passé respectif, éclairant leur cheminement vers le présent et ayant peut-être la chance de changer leur avenir.

programme.title: Les inconnus: chapitre 2
programme.desc: Dans un village, Maya et son amoureux Ryan sont attaqués sans raison apparente par trois psychopathes sanguinaires masqués. En retrouvant ses sens à l'hôpital, Maya apprend qu'elle a échappé à l'assaut, mais que Ryan est décédé de ses blessures. La chasse reprend de plus belle alors que les mystérieux tueurs qui l'ont ciblée au hasard se lancent de nouveau à ses trousses.

programme.title: Mesures funèbres
programme.desc: Audrey Benac affronte son passé et son destin en plongeant dans la vie de Kathleen Parlow, une violoniste canadienne oubliée. Délaissant sa mère mourante, elle-même violoniste ratée, Audrey est hantée par les rêves inachevés de celle-ci et cherche un sens à sa vie.

Lorsque ses supérieurs refusent d'agir, il prend les choses en main et se lance dans un dangereux périple à travers le monde pour retrouver les responsables, son intelligence lui servant d'arme ultime pour échapper à ses poursuivants et se venger.

Dès sa première rencontre avec son client en garde à vue et tout au long de l'enquête, Nora découvre la cruauté du monde qui entoure sa vie privée et professionnelle. Alors que Pierre n'a qu'une idée en tête, la ramener d'urgence et reprendre une vie normale, rien ne se passe comme prévu.

programme.desc: Ideales del respeto, la comunicación asertiva y retos de superación, de la mano con herramientas útiles para un sinfín de áreas de la vida. Promover valores, liderazgo y emprendimiento.

programme.title: Se ha dicho
programme.desc: Una abogada que servirá de mediadora en los conflictos legales que son contados por los participantes y que en muchos casos sorprenderán y conmoverán a la teleaudiencia.

programme.title: Consentidos Estrellas
programme.desc: Un programa infantil cuyo objetivo es la diversión mediante el aprendizaje.

programme.title: Gente Como Uno
programme.desc: Las hermanas Braun dan secretos a las mujeres para que siempre se vean hermosas y saludables.

programme.title: El hada de las pesas
programme.desc: Bok-joo es una levantadora de pesas que persigue el sueño de ganar una medalla de oro, pero en su camino encuentra el amor. Concentrarse en su aspiración deportiva pondría en peligro su relación, pero si lo deja, su sueño se vería frustrado.

programme.title: Monteverde
programme.desc: Monteverde queda marcado por historias de amor, amistad, intriga y esperanza de encontrar la felicidad.

programme.title: Nacer contigo
programme.desc: Celeste es una mujer despechada que encuentra la oportunidad de vengarse de Pleberio Fuentes, el hombre que la dejó en el pasado por otra mujer. Su plan es arruinar la vida amorosa de la hija de Pleberio, para que la joven sienta lo mismo que ella.

programme.title: Te necesito
programme.desc: El dulce amor de Pink Juice se convirtió en rencor al descubrir que su amante Lue mantenía en secreto una aventura con otra mujer.

programme.title: Sox
programme.desc: Dos familias, unidas a través del matrimonio, tienen problemas para congeniar. Sin embargo, la llegada de un perro muy especial a sus vidas logrará que empiecen a llevarse mejor.

programme.title: Las aventuras de Spirou y Fantasio
programme.desc: Las aventuras de Spirou, un pequeño ladrón vestido de repartidor, y Fantasio, un periodista en bancarrota. Cuando el malvado Zorglub secuestra al conde de Champignac, los dos amigos tendrán que afrontar la misión más peligrosa de sus vidas.

programme.title: Momentum
programme.desc: Un asesino y su equipo persiguen a un ladrón profesional en la Ciudad del Cabo, Sudáfrica.

programme.title: Nuevo rico, nuevo pobre
programme.desc: Un empresario y un chico de barrio descubren que los cambiaron al nacer. Ambos empiezan a vivir la vida en los zapatos del otro y descubren muchas cosas que jamás habían pensado.

programme.title: Leandro Díaz
programme.desc: Bionovela basada en la vida del compositor y artista colombiano Leandro Díaz, símbolo del vallenato.

programme.title: Los hilos del pasado
programme.desc: Convertida en una célebre diseñadora de modas, Carolina será la encargada de lastimar el día a día de Cristina ante el amor que vive con su hijastro Alfredo.

programme.title: No desista
programme.desc: Un joven emprendedor encuentra un inesperado socio y amigo en un hombre maduro que trabaja para ganarse la vida. Ambos comparten la casa de una enigmática prestamista. ★ 4.4/10

programme.title: Problemas y soluciones
programme.desc: Se tratan casos impactantes sobre trabajos de brujería y depresión, y cómo, por medio de la oración, la paz regresa a la vida de las personas.

programme.title: La vida oscura del gran duque de Córcega
programme.desc: En 1221, un joven quiere convertirse en San Francisco de Asís. Mil años después, un arquitecto tiene que construir un mausoleo para un multimillonario moribundo.

programme.title: El rastro del delito
programme.desc: Un oficial de policía que había estado tomando alcohol con sus compañeros durante su servicio atropella a un niño. Aunque miente al respecto de lo sucedido, los dos detectives asignados al caso no creen su versión de los hechos.

programme.title: Ciudad de sombras
programme.desc: Un exoficial de policía se involucra en un gran escándalo después de ser contratado para seguir a la esposa infiel del alcalde.

programme.title: Seuls face à l'Alaska

programme.title: Direction la mer

programme.title: Condensé de science

Si les sondes peuvent servir à explorer les confins de notre univers, on peut espérer qu'elles pourront éventuellement éviter une collision entre un astéroïde et la Terre.

programme.title: Nordicité

programme.title: Créatures microscopiques

programme.title: Créatures microscopiques
programme.desc: Utiliser un microscope pour voir la différence entre le lait cru et le lait pasteurisé.

programme.title: Condensé de science

Des expert.e.s nous dévoilent les secrets enfouis dans la région de Manicouagan. Découvrez l'ampleur de ce choc colossal survenu il y a 214 millions d'années.

Une diversité incroyable de protoplanètes s'est formée autour de notre Soleil, c'est-à-dire les huit planètes composant notre système solaire: Mercure, Vénus, Terre, Mars, Jupiter, Saturne, Uranus et Neptune.

programme.desc: Two thieves dressed as fake cops steal half-billion dollars' worth of artwork from a Boston museum. Numerous suspects turn up dead, while the paintings remain missing.

programme.title: WWE Legends
programme.desc: The British Bulldog, Davey Boy Smith, arguably the greatest British wrestler of all time, lived a life of extreme highs and extreme lows. At 15 years old, Davey Boy began his wrestling career as the youngest British wrestler ever and went on to achieve worldwide fame while main eventing London's Wembley Stadium.

programme.title: Nine Lives of...
programme.desc: Arnold Schwarzenegger harnessed his relentless drive to transcend multiple scandals and secure his place as an indelible icon of American culture.

programme.title: NHK World English News
programme.desc: English news from Japan's Broadcasting Corporation, NHK, delivering the latest in business, technology, health, environmental and world news.

programme.title: Al Jazeera News Hour
programme.desc: In-depth global news from Al Jazeera Satellite Network, Doha, Qatar, in English.

programme.title: TRT World News
programme.desc: The latest news from around the globe from TRT World, Istanbul, Turkiye, in English.

programme.title: France 24 Africa News
programme.desc: Join France24's Georja Calvin-Smith for a round up of the week's cultural and current affairs stories from across the African continent. Delivered via satellite from Paris, in English, no subtitles. Watch on SBS VICELAND at 06:30am every Sunday, also available on SBS OnDemand.

programme.title: DW English News
programme.desc: News and analysis of the top international and European news and current affairs from Berlin, in English.

programme.title: FBC News
programme.desc: Local, world, sport and entertainment news in English from FBC News, Suva Fiji.

programme.title: France 24 Feature
programme.desc: News feature in English from France 24, Paris.

programme.title: euronews
programme.desc: Headlines, Breaking News & Analysis from the Euronews news centre in Brussels, Belgium, in English.

programme.title: Global Us
programme.desc: Deutsche Welle's news magazine looks at the issues that are moving us today and shows how people are living with the opportunities and risks of globalisation.

programme.title: CBC The National
programme.desc: CBC's flagship nightly news with hosts Adrienne Arsenault and Andrew Chang from Toronto, Canada. Watch on SBS VICELAND at 08:40am everyday, also available on SBS OnDemand.
