programme.title: Annie & Joey
programme.desc: Annie est sur un nuage depuis les excuses de Joey ; soucieux de se racheter, il l'invite à une escapade romantique ; l'arrivée inattendue de la petite Marguerite laisse Sylvain et Amanda complètement dépassés.

programme.title: FBI: International
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un Américain est kidnappé à Varsovie avec une Ukrainienne rencontrée sur un site de rencontres, l'équipe se rend en Pologne pour retrouver le cerveau derrière le site.

programme.title: FBI: recherchés
programme.desc: L'équipe s'efforce d'attraper celui qui menace de faire exploser une bombe à Manhattan; pendant ce temps, Ray se prépare à célébrer une étape importante de sa vie à l'approche de son mariage avec Cora.

programme.title: FBI
programme.desc: Le groupe terroriste somalien qui a causé la mort de l'agent Hobbs refait surface, entraînant l'équipe dans une course-poursuite pour arrêter définitivement chacun de ses membres.

programme.title: NCIS: Nouvelle-Orléans
programme.desc: Pendant que Pride et Rita planifient leurs noces, le FBI arrête Connor ; son arrestation, qui chamboule les plans heureux de Pride et de Rita, est en lien avec l'attentat à la bombe au bar.

programme.title: NCIS: origines
programme.desc: L'équipe enquête sur le meurtre brutal d'une sergente militaire retrouvée brûlée dans sa voiture, une affaire que Franks soupçonne d'avoir un lien avec l'agression de son ex-femme, Tish.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: La famille doit affronter la dure réalité de la sécheresse à Heartland, et la course est lancée pour trouver l'endroit idéal où creuser un nouveau puits. Pendant ce temps, Katie s'inquiète pour la santé de son grand-père.

programme.title: Blue Bloods
programme.desc: Les tentatives de Danny et Baez pour retrouver la personne qui a agressé un propriétaire de magasin sont entravées par le refus d'une communauté tissée serrée de coopérer à l'enquête ; Erin est de plus en plus suspicieuse à l'égard de sa patronne.

programme.title: Détectives privés
programme.desc: C'est le jour du mariage de Danica et Kate; une tempête imprévue bloque leurs invités sur l'île où a lieu la cérémonie, en Ontario.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Afin de se préparer à se glisser dans la peau d'un nouveau personnage, une célèbre actrice suit pas à pas l'équipe du NCIS au cours d'une enquête sur un meurtre par décapitation.

programme.title: Nurses: états de grâce
programme.desc: Des fantômes du passé hantent les couloirs de l'hôpital St. Mary; leurs cibles principales sont les infirmiers et infirmières.

programme.title: Meurtre sur la côte ouest
programme.desc: Cassandra raccompagne chez elle sa riche amie Emma O'Brien après une collecte de fonds, mais découvre une scène horrifique dans le bureau de son mari : du sang partout et un coffre-fort vidé. Alors que les soupçons se tournent vers Emma, Albert remarque un détail inhabituel sur la scène de crime, entraînant Cassandra dans une affaire bien plus complexe que prévu et mettant leur relation à l'épreuve.

programme.title: CSI: Vegas
programme.desc: Le corps d'une jeune fille assassinée il y a plus de 40 ans est retrouvé au fond du lac Mead; Max promet à sa mère que l'équipe du CSI rendra enfin justice à sa fille; Greg Sanders est de retour au laboratoire.

programme.title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom
programme.desc: Three years after the destruction of the Jurassic World theme park, Owen Grady and Claire Dearing return to the island of Isla Nublar to save the remaining dinosaurs from a volcano that's about to erupt. They soon encounter terrifying new breeds of gigantic dinos while uncovering a conspiracy that threatens the entire planet.

programme.title: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: Four years after "Jurassic Park," mathematician Ian Malcolm ventures onto a second island to save his girlfriend from becoming dinosaur bait.

programme.title: Green Lantern
programme.desc: Sworn to preserve intergalactic order, the Green Lantern Corps has existed for centuries. Its newest recruit, Hal Jordan, is the first human to join the ranks. The Green Lanterns have little regard for humans, who have thus far been unable to harness the powers of the ring each member wears. But Jordan, a gifted and cocky test pilot, may be the corps' only hope when a new enemy called Parallax threatens the universal balance of power.

programme.title: Face to Face With David
programme.desc: David Oulton interviews guests form the worlds of entertainment, business, fashion and politics.

programme.title: Tempted by Danger
programme.desc: A successful attorney begins a new relationship with an executive who becomes increasingly obsessed with her.

programme.title: Border Security: America's Front Line
programme.desc: A dentist from Kiev hopes for an extended stay in the U.S. after fleeing war in her home country; a traveler headed to Vegas points to a friend as the source of the extra cash he's carrying.

programme.title: Doin' It
programme.desc: Moonlighting as a high-school substitute teacher, a 30-year-old virgin gets in over her head when she's assigned to teach sex education.

programme.title: Harold & Kumar Go to White Castle
programme.desc: Nerdy accountant Harold (John Cho) and his irrepressible friend, Kumar (Kal Penn), get stoned watching television and find themselves utterly bewitched by a commercial for White Castle. Convinced there must be one nearby, the two set out on a late-night odyssey that takes them deep into New Jersey. Somehow, the boys manage to run afoul of rednecks, cops and even a car-stealing Neil Patrick Harris before getting anywhere near their beloved sliders.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: Set in 1973, it chronicles the funny and often poignant coming of age of 15-year-old William, an unabashed music fan who is inspired by the seminal bands of the time. When his love of music lands him an assignment from Rolling Stone Magazine to interview the up-and-coming band Stillwater -- fronted by lead guitar Russell Hammond and lead singer Jeff Bebe, William embarks on an eye-opening journey with the band's tour, despite the objections of his protective mother.

programme.title: Vanilla Sky
programme.desc: Tom Cruise and Cameron Crowe reunite after "Jerry Maguire" for "Vanilla Sky," the story of a young New York City publishing magnate who finds himself on an unexpected roller-coaster ride of romance, comedy, suspicion, love, sex and dreams in a mind-bending search for his soul.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Based on the popular Tom Clancy novel, this suspenseful movie tracks Soviet submarine captain Marko Ramius as he abandons his orders and heads for the east coast of the United States. Equipped with innovative stealth technology, Ramius' submarine, "Red October," is virtually invisible. However, when an American sub briefly detects the Russians' presence, CIA agent Jack Ryan sets out to determine Ramius' motives, fearing he may launch an attack on the U.S.

programme.title: Holes
programme.desc: A boy and his friends question the motives of a woman (Sigourney Weaver) who forces them to dig holes at a detention camp.

programme.title: The Hurricane
programme.desc: Denzel Washington is Rubin "Hurricane" Carter, a man whose dreams of winning the middleweight boxing title were destroyed when he was arrested along with another man for the murders of 3 people in a New Jersey bar. Wrongfully accused, Carter and John Artis were sentenced to 3 life terms in prison.

programme.title: Ali
programme.desc: With wit and athletic genius, with defiant rage and inner grace, Muhammad Ali forever changed the American landscape. Fighting all comers, Ali took on the law, conventions, the status quo and the war -- as well as the fists in front of him. Ali both ignited and mirrored the conflicts of his time and ours to become one of the most admired fighters in the world. Forget, now, what you thought you knew.

programme.title: Gasoline Alley
programme.desc: Set in the underbelly of Los Angeles, a man is drawn into a high-profile triple murder. The two police detectives on his tail soon join him in attempting to uncover an explosive conspiracy.

programme.title: Good Kill
programme.desc: An Air Force drone pilot (Ethan Hawke) begins to question the ethics of dropping bombs on Afghanistan from the safety of his post in Las Vegas.

programme.title: Hotel Artemis
programme.desc: As rioting rocks Los Angeles in the year 2028, disgruntled thieves make their way to Hotel Artemis -- a 13-story, members-only hospital for criminals. It's operated by the Nurse, a no-nonsense, high-tech healer who already has her hands full of a French assassin, an arms dealer and an injured cop. As the violence of the night continues, the Nurse must decide whether to break her own rules and confront what she's worked so hard to avoid.

programme.title: Memory
programme.desc: Social worker Sylvia's structured life is blown apart when Saul follows her home from their high school reunion. Their surprise encounter profoundly impacts both of them as they open the door to the past.

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe.

programme.title: Cheech & Chong's Last Movie
programme.desc: Cheech Marin and Tommy Chong discuss their lifelong friendship and popularity as a comedic duo. Features interviews, sketches and never-before-seen footage spanning their five-decade career.

programme.title: Grudge Match
programme.desc: Pittsburgh boxers Billy "The Kid" McDonnen (Robert De Niro) and Henry "Razor" Sharp (Sylvester Stallone) shared a fierce rivalry back in the 1980s. Each had scored a victory in two matches, but on the eve of their decisive third bout, Henry suddenly announced his retirement, effectively ending both boxers' careers. Thirty years later, boxing promoter Dante Slate Jr. (Kevin Hart) makes Billy and Henry an offer they can't refuse: Return to the ring and settle the score once and for all.

programme.title: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa
programme.desc: Irascible Irving Zisman and his young and impressionable grandson, Billy, set out on a road trip across America. Hidden cameras capture their insane and shocking encounters with a diverse set of unsuspecting citizens, including male strippers, disgruntled contestants (and their mothers) from a children's beauty pageant, mourners at a funeral home, patrons at a biker bar and more. Based on the "Jackass" TV series.

programme.title: Jackass: The Movie
programme.desc: In this comedic documentary, Johnny Knoxville heads a crew of stuntmen, skateboarders and all-around lunatics as they prank, embarrass and torture each other in the name of fun. The antics range from childlike -- the boys don panda suits for a romp through Tokyo -- to grotesque and life-threatening. A golf cart demolition derby turns downright dangerous. Live gators nearly chomp maniac Steve-O. Filmmaker Spike Jonze and Knoxville, in heavy makeup, test the public's patience for the elderly.

programme.title: Jackass: Number Two
programme.desc: Daredevils (Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Steve-O) go for the gross-out when they subject an unsuspecting public to more outrageous stunts and practical jokes. Danger, pain and bodily fluids are in plentiful supply as the gang tries to up the ante in the continuous quest to shock and annoy.

programme.title: Rumours
programme.desc: Leaders of the world's wealthiest democracies gather for the annual G7 summit to draft a provisional statement regarding a global crisis. They soon become spectacles of incompetence, contending with increasingly surreal obstacles as night falls in the misty woods and they realize they are suddenly alone.

programme.title: Top Secret!
programme.desc: Popular and dashing American singer Nick Rivers (Val Kilmer) travels to East Germany to perform in a music festival. When he loses his heart to the gorgeous Hillary Flammond (Lucy Gutteridge), he finds himself caught up in an underground resistance movement. Rivers joins forces with Agent Cedric (Omar Sharif) and Flammond to attempt the rescue of her father, Dr. Paul (Michael Gough), from the Germans, who have captured the scientist in hopes of coercing him into building a new naval mine.

programme.title: Mob Town
programme.desc: The FBI and a local cop track various members of organized crime families as they gather for a huge meeting in upstate New York in 1957.

programme.title: Holes
programme.desc: A boy and his friends question the motives of a woman (Sigourney Weaver) who forces them to dig holes at a detention camp.

programme.title: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: The four nations of Air, Water, Earth and Fire lived in harmony until the Fire Nation declared war. A century later, there is still no end in sight to the destruction, then, an Avatar named Aang (Noah Ringer) discovers that he has the power to control the four elements. He joins forces with Katara (Nicola Peltz), a Waterbender, and her brother, Sokka, to restore balance and harmony to their world.

programme.title: Sahara
programme.desc: Seasoned adventurer Dirk Pitt (Matthew McConaughey) sets out for the African desert with his sarcastic companion (Steve Zahn) in search of a ship rumored to have vanished long ago, the main draw being the treasure supposedly hidden within the lost vessel. When the daring duo come across a beautiful scientist (Penélope Cruz) who is juggling an escape from a warlord and a mission to stop the spread of a powerful plague, their desert expedition begins to heat up.

programme.title: Wayne's World
programme.desc: A big screen spin-off of the "Saturday Night Live" skit. Rob Lowe plays a producer that wants to take the public access "Wayne's World" to the world of commercial television. Wayne (Mike Myers) and Garth (Dana Carvey) battle to save their show and Wayne's girlfriend from Lowe.

programme.title: Blue Chips
programme.desc: Pete Bell (Nick Nolte) is a college basketball coach who has to improve his team's standing -- by any means necessary. His hopes are pinned on a trio of talented players: Neon Boudeaux (Shaquille O'Neal), Butch McRae (Penny Hardaway) and Ricky Roe (Matt Nover). But in order to get them to sign to his school, Bell will have to illegally pay the players off. If he's caught, it could destroy Bell's coaching career and cast a cloud of shame over his team. Will he risk it all to win?

programme.title: Harriet the Spy
programme.desc: Harriet (Michelle Trachtenberg) may only be in the sixth grade, but she's already found her calling: to be a spy. In a private journal she takes everywhere, Harriet records suspicious activity and keeps a running list of observations on virtually everyone she knows. It seems harmless enough until, one day, someone finds the journal and exposes Harriet's critical thoughts about her classmates. Suddenly, even her best friends are against her, and Harriet resolves to take revenge.

programme.title: The Truman Show
programme.desc: He doesn't know it, but everything in Truman Burbank's (Jim Carrey) life is part of a massive TV set. Executive producer Christof (Ed Harris) orchestrates "The Truman Show," a live broadcast of Truman's every move captured by hidden cameras. Christof tries to control Truman's mind, even removing his true love, Sylvia (Natascha McElhone), from the show and replacing her with Meryl (Laura Linney). As Truman gradually discovers the truth, however, he must decide whether to act on it.

programme.title: Jeff, Who Lives at Home
programme.desc: When Jeff (Jason Segel) leaves his mother's basement to buy wood glue at the store, he looks for signs from the universe to determine his path. However, a series of unexpected and amusing events leads him to cross paths with his family, especially his brother (Ed Helms), in the strangest of circumstances and locations. If Jeff is very lucky and universally blessed, he will find the meaning of his life... and remember to buy the wood glue as well.

programme.title: Strange Wilderness
programme.desc: Peter Gaulke takes over when his father, a respected wildlife TV host, dies, but receives far less success. When the show is threatened with cancellation, Peter and his know-nothing crew of stoners and idiots realize that only one creature can save the show: Bigfoot.

programme.title: The Road
programme.desc: America is a grim, gray shadow of itself after a catastrophe. A man (Viggo Mortensen) and his young son (Kodi Smit-McPhee) wander through this post-apocalyptic world, trying to keep the dream of civilization alive. They journey toward the sea, surviving as best they can on what they can scavenge, and try to avoid roving gangs of savage humans who will turn them into slaves, or worse.

programme.title: American Son
programme.desc: A freshly graduated Marine returns home to his dysfunctional family for Thanksgiving.

programme.title: Marshmallow
programme.desc: A 12-year-old boy starts to see a shadowy figure in the woods after hearing a spooky story at summer camp.

programme.title: Old Guy
programme.desc: An aging hit man must train a young prodigy when his employer moves to replace the old guard. However, when they learn they're being betrayed, the unlikely pair turns into a lethal team -- with their double-crossing bosses in their sights.

programme.title: Into the Wild
programme.desc: A top student and athlete leaves his middle-class life to venture into Alaska, only to meet people who will eventually shape his values and life.

programme.title: Seven Psychopaths
programme.desc: Boozy writer Marty (Colin Farrell) is a man in search of a screenplay. He has a catchy title but no story to go along with it. Marty has a couple of oddball buddies, Hans (Christopher Walken) and Billy (Sam Rockwell), who make a living by kidnapping rich people's dogs, then returning them and collecting the reward. However this time, the fur flies when Hans and Billy kidnap the beloved pooch of a gangster (Woody Harrelson), and Marty uses the ensuing events as fodder for his screenplay.

programme.title: Terminator: Dark Fate
programme.desc: In Mexico City, a newly modified liquid Terminator -- the Rev-9 model -- arrives from the future to kill a young factory worker named Dani Ramos. Also sent back in time is Grace, a hybrid cyborg human who must protect Ramos from the seemingly indestructible robotic assassin. But the two women soon find some much-needed help from a pair of unexpected allies -- seasoned warrior Sarah Connor and the T-800 Terminator.

programme.title: The Corrupted
programme.desc: Released from prison, a talented boxer wants nothing more than to reconnect with his young son and live a quiet life. But when his brother gets on the wrong side of a shady developer, he must risk everything to save his sibling before it's too late.

programme.title: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa 0.5
programme.desc: Irving Zisman takes his young and impressionable grandson on a cross-country trip in which they encounter male strippers, biker-bar patrons and other unsuspecting citizens.

programme.title: The Dictator
programme.desc: Gen. Aladeen (Sacha Baron Cohen) has ruled the oil-rich North African country of Wadiya since the age of six, when 97 stray bullets and a hand grenade killed his father in a hunting accident. After an assassination attempt takes the life of yet another body-double, Tamir (Ben Kingsley), Aladeen's uncle and most trusted adviser, convinces Aladeen to go to New York. Unfortunately, Aladeen has a less-than-friendly reception from exiled Wadiyans, who want their country freed from his despotic rule.

programme.title: Not Without Hope
programme.desc: Four friends face disaster when their boat capsizes in the Gulf of Mexico. Battling massive waves, sharks, dehydration and hypothermia, they cling to hope as Capt. Timothy Close and his Coast Guard crew launch a daring rescue through a raging storm to save them.

programme.title: The Aviator
programme.desc: Billionaire and aviation tycoon Howard Hughes (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a successful public figure: a director of big-budget Hollywood films such as "Hell's Angels," a passionate lover of Hollywood leading ladies Katharine Hepburn (Cate Blanchett) and Ava Gardner (Kate Beckinsale), and an aviation pioneer who helps build TWA into a major airline. But in private, Hughes remains tormented, suffering from paralyzing phobias and depression. The higher he rises, the farther has to fall.

programme.title: Scream 2
programme.desc: Sydney (Neve Campbell) and tabloid reporter Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) survived the events of the first Scream, but their nightmare isn't over. When two college students are murdered at a sneak preview of Stab, a movie based on the events from the first film, it's clear a copycat killer is on the loose. Sydney and Gail, as well as fellow survivors Deputy Dewey (David Arquette) and Randy (Jamie Kennedy) have to find out who is behind this new murder spree, before they all end up dead.

programme.title: Scream 3
programme.desc: In the final installment to this trilogy, a murder spree begins to happen again; this time targeted toward the original Woodsboro survivors and those associated with the movie-inside-a-movie, Stab 3. Sydney must face the demons of her past to stop the killer(s).

programme.title: Scream 4
programme.desc: It has been many years since the Ghostface Killer cut a deadly path through the town of Woodsboro. In order to get over the trauma of those horrific events, Sidney Prescott (Neve Campbell) has written a self-help book. She returns to Woodsboro for her book tour, and reconnects with old friends Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) and Sheriff Dewey (David Arquette). However, Sidney's arrival also sparks the return of Ghostface, putting Sidney and everyone she loves in danger.

programme.title: Asking for It
programme.desc: A victim of sexual assault joins an all-female gang that targets violent frat boys and a corrupt police force of human traffickers.

programme.title: Backcountry
programme.desc: A couple (Missy Peregrym, Jeff Roop) on a deep-wilderness hike become hopelessly lost within an aggressive black bear's territory.

programme.title: Miles to Go Before I Sleep
programme.desc: The relationships between musicians and their road crews and the importance of the people who work to put shows together.

programme.title: The Evening Star
programme.desc: A spunky woman (Shirley MacLaine) copes with her troubled adult grandchildren, feuds with an enemy and has a fling with a younger man (Bill Paxton).

programme.title: Alone in Berlin
programme.desc: A German couple lose their son in WWII, prompting them to become secretly anti-Nazi.

programme.title: Things We Lost in the Fire
programme.desc: After her husband dies in an act of senseless violence, Audrey Burke (Halle Berry) is left alone with two young children and no idea how to cope. Nearly paralyzed by grief, Audrey tracks down her husband's childhood friend, Jerry (Benicio del Toro). Jerry is a drug addict, but Audrey invites him to move into her home nevertheless, and a mutually dependent relationship develops between the two damaged souls.

programme.title: Losing Isaiah
programme.desc: Khaila Richards (Halle Berry), a crack-addicted single mother, accidentally leaves her baby in a dumpster while high and returns the next day in a panic to find he is missing. In reality, the baby has been adopted by a warm-hearted social worker, Margaret Lewin (Jessica Lange), and her husband, Charles (David Strathairn). Years later, Khaila has gone through rehab and holds a steady job. After learning that her child is still alive, she challenges Margaret for the custody.

programme.title: Django Unchained
programme.desc: Two years before the Civil War, Django (Jamie Foxx), a slave, finds himself accompanying an unorthodox German bounty hunter named Dr. King Schultz (Christoph Waltz) on a mission to capture the vicious Brittle brothers. Their mission successful, Schultz frees Django, and together they hunt the South's most-wanted criminals. Their travels take them to the infamous plantation of shady Calvin Candie (Leonardo DiCaprio), where Django's long-lost wife (Kerry Washington) is still a slave.

programme.title: The Chi
programme.desc: The South Side of Chicago carries daily danger, and the smallest and simplest of decisions can have life or death consequences for the residents. Life continues as the kids prep for school and their parents shuffle off to work. The young adults of the area are trying to scrape a living for themselves, while the elders sit on their front porches and observe the goings on. The South Side has the potential to crush dreams, and this coming-of-age series focuses on Kevin, a preteen who embraces the normal rites of childhood, Brandon, who makes a leap of faith to succeed in love and life with Jerrika, Emmett, who seeks guidance from his mother, and Ronnie, who is a drifter struggling to be loved. All of them are linked together by sheer coincidence as they seek redemption.

programme.title: Sound of Violence
programme.desc: A young killer experiences intense pleasure whenever she hears the sound of human pain.

programme.title: The Fabulous Four
programme.desc: Lifelong friends travel to Key West, Fla., to be bridesmaids in a college girlfriend's surprise wedding. Over the course of one outrageous trip, sisterhoods are rekindled, the past resurfaces, and there are enough sparks, sex and romance to change all of their lives in unexpected ways.

programme.title: Pelé: Birth of a Legend
programme.desc: Under guidance from manager Vicente Feola (Vincent D'Onofrio), young Pelé (Kevin de Paula) utilizes his street soccer skills to lead Brazil to the World Cup in 1958.

programme.title: Mr. Hobbs Takes a Vacation
programme.desc: Banker Roger Hobbs (James Stewart) wants to spend his vacation alone with his wife, Peggy (Maureen O'Hara), but she insists on a family vacation at a California beach house that turns out to be ugly and broken down. Daughter Katey (Lauri Peters), embarrassed by her braces, refuses to go to the beach, as does TV-addicted son Danny (Michael Burns). When the family is joined by Hobbs' two unhappily married daughters and their husbands, he must help everyone with their problems to get some peace.

programme.title: The Terror of Tiny Town
programme.desc: In the Old West's Tiny Town, Bat Haines ("Little Billy" Rhodes) pits two ranching families, the Lawsons and the Prestons, against each other by stealing their cattle and blaming the other family for the thefts. Haines blackmails the sheriff, who is an ex-convict, into taking no action, then attacks a stagecoach carrying Nancy (Yvonne Moray), the niece of Tex Preston. Nancy is rescued by Buck Lawson (Billy Curtis), and the two fall in love. Billy then battles Haines to stop the feud.

programme.title: Wanted: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: A woman's past provides a motive for why she murdered her fugitive husband.

programme.title: True North Classics
programme.desc: The best in short film from the 1930s to 1960s.

programme.title: Postcards From Canada
programme.desc: Images of the East Coast and Canadian Winters.

programme.title: Retrola: Canada's Time Machine
programme.desc: Images of Toronto transit and Christmas.

programme.title: Classroom Classics
programme.desc: Featuring "How to Be Well Groomed" and "Holiday From Rules.".

programme.title: Lux Radio Theatre
programme.desc: Starring William Powell.

programme.title: Lux Radio Theatre
programme.desc: Starring Alan Ladd.

programme.title: Lux Radio Theatre
programme.desc: Starring Ronald Coleman.

programme.title: Lux Radio Theatre

programme.desc: Wildlife rehabilitation expert Hope Swinimer and her dedicated team rescue and heal injured and orphaned animals of all kinds. "Hope in the Wild" educates viewers on the day-to-day jobs of this animal care team and the varied species the team encounters. This show is specifically designed to further the educational and informational needs of children.

Culture shock and opposition from local law enforcement combine to hinder his progress and that of his elite team, but a sympathetic Saudi police captain becomes an unexpected comrade-in-arms.

As they celebrate the latest job, a former associate arrives with a daring plan to rob an armored car. The lure of so much cash is too tempting to resist but, unbeknown to Gordon's men, this heist puts them on a collision course with Russian mobsters and a detective (Matt Dillon) who will do anything to capture them.

To achieve his goal, he recruits musclemen Paul (Dwayne Johnson) and Adrian (Anthony Mackie) as accomplices. After several failed attempts, they abduct rich businessman Victor Kershaw (Tony Shalhoub) and convince him to sign over all his assets to them. But when Kershaw makes it out alive, authorities are reluctant to believe his story.

Streetwise and jobless, he has not only fathered two children by two different women-Yvette (Taraji P. Henson) and Peanut (Tamara LaSeon Bass) but still lives with his own mother. He can't seem to strike a balance or find direction in his chaotic life.

programme.desc: Megan's teenage daughter, Whitney, disappears after their car breaks down at a gas station. As a shadowy figure traps Whitney in a deadly game of survival, Megan scrambles to uncover the truth before she's lost forever.

programme.desc: A quiet Tennessee couple returns home to a nightmare, burglars lurking in the shadows, a home invasion turning deadly.

programme.title: Finally Caught
programme.desc: Denita Smith, a 25-year-old graduate student in North Carolina, is murdered on January 4, 2007; before her tragic death, Shannon Crawley, who had a complicated history with Denita's fiance, Jermeir Stroud, became extremely jealous.

programme.title: Winnie Mandela
programme.desc: The story of South African politician Winnie Mandela (Jennifer Hudson).

programme.title: Internal Affairs
programme.desc: In the Los Angeles Police Department, Officer Dennis Peck (Richard Gere) is a divisive figure, loved by those who are loyal to him and looked on with suspicion by others. His disreputable behavior and dubious finances arouse the suspicion of Internal Affairs, and Sgt. Raymond Avila (Andy Garcia) and his partner (Laurie Metcalf) are assigned to investigate. When a series of witnesses are murdered, Avila realizes his life is in danger, along with that of his wife's (Nancy Travis).

programme.desc: Four ne'er-do-well sons reunite in their Texas hometown to attend their mother's funeral. Led by older brothers John (John Wayne), a gunfighter, and Tom (Dean Martin), a gambler, the four soon learn that their father gambled away the family ranch, which was the cause of his murder. The brothers decide to avenge their father's death and win back the ranch, a situation that quickly leads to trouble with the local sheriff and violent conflict with the rival Hastings clan.

programme.title: The Boy in the Striped Pajamas
programme.desc: During World War II, 8-year-old Bruno (Asa Butterfield) and his family leave Berlin to take up residence near the concentration camp where his father (David Thewlis) has just become commandant. Unhappy and lonely, he wanders out behind his house one day and finds Shmuel (Jack Scanlon), a Jewish boy of his age. Though the barbed-wire fence of the camp separates them, the boys begin a forbidden friendship, oblivious to the real nature of their surroundings.

programme.title: Horses of McBride
programme.desc: The residents of a small Canadian town band together to dig a milelong trench through deep snow to rescue two starving abandoned horses.

programme.title: A Shine of Rainbows
programme.desc: A lonely orphan's life is transformed by a woman who teaches him to conquer grief and discover the magic in nature and himself.

programme.title: Backstabbing for Beginners
programme.desc: Michael, a young United Nations employee, travels to Iraq with his mentor, who wants to show him how successful the UN's Oil-for-Food Program has been. When Michael gets a deeper look at the organization, he unveils a corruption conspiracy in which officials - both inside and outside of the UN - are skimming billions off the top of the aid meant for the Iraqi people.

programme.title: Les Hauts de Hurle-Vent
programme.desc: Une histoire d'amour ardente et tourmentée, ancrée dans les paysages sauvages des landes du Yorkshire, qui met en lumière la relation intense et dévastatrice entre Heathcliff et Catherine Earnshaw.

programme.title: Beau a peur
programme.desc: Un homme paranoïaque se lance dans une odyssée épique pour retrouver sa mère.

programme.title: Bones and All
programme.desc: Maren, une jeune femme apprenant à survivre en marge de la société, découvre l'amour avec Lee, un intense et marginal vagabond. Ensemble, ils s'embarquent dans une odyssée de mille kilomètres qui les amène à traverser les routes délaissées de l'Amérique profonde de Ronald Reagan. En dépit de leurs efforts pour échapper à leurs passés terrifiants, tout les ramène à leurs démons.

programme.title: Le royaume de la planète des singes
programme.desc: Plusieurs générations après le règne de César, les singes ont définitivement pris le pouvoir. Les humains, quant à eux, ont régressé à l'état sauvage et vivent en retrait.

programme.title: Pédalo
programme.desc: Deux couples d'amis partent dans un tout-inclus à Cuba pour fuir l'hiver. Très vite, Claudia, la conjointe de Sébastien, plonge un peu trop dans l'alcool. Tandis que Bruno réalise que d'inviter Mia, rencontrée lors d'un cinq à sept deux semaines plus tôt, n'était peut-être pas l'idée du siècle. En quête de liberté, les deux acolytes décident de partir en pédalo. L'escapade en mer vire en fiasco et ils se perdent quelque part au large de Cuba, pendant que les femmes s'apprivoisent.

programme.title: Harry Potter et le prince de sang-mêlé
programme.desc: Cette sixième année scolaire de Harry Potter à l'école de sorciers commence par une dispute avec son ennemi juré Draco Malfoy, en qui les forces des ténèbres placent désormais leurs espoirs. Accaparés par les émois et les malentendus amoureux, Hermione et Ron remarquent à peine que Harry enquête à la demande de Dumbledore sur le passé du professeur Slughorn. Entré dans le cercle des intimes de l'enseignant sur la foi de bonnes notes grâce à un manuel scolaire annoté, Harry se rapproche du but.

programme.title: Harry Potter et les reliques de la mort : 1ère partie
programme.desc: Sans les conseils et la protection de leurs professeurs, Harry, Ron et Hermione ont pour mission de détruire les horcruxes, les origines de l'immortalité de Voldemort. Bien que plus que jamais ils doivent compter l'un sur l'autre, les forces du mal menacent de les désunir. Les Death Eaters de Voldemort ont pris le contrôle du ministère de la Magie et de Hogwarts et ils recherchent Harry. Aussi Harry et ses amis se préparent pour la dernière confrontation.

programme.title: Harry Potter et les reliques de la mort - 2e partie
programme.desc: Dans la deuxième partie de cette finale épique, la bataille entre les forces du bien et celles du mal du monde des magiciens dégénère en une guerre tous azimuts. Les enjeux n'ont jamais été si grands et personne n'est en sécurité. Mais c'est peut-être Harry Potter qui pourrait être appelé à faire le sacrifice ultime alors qu'il se rapproche de la confrontation tant attendue avec Lord Voldemort. Tout se termine ici.

programme.title: Harry Potter : Retour à Poudlard - 20 ans de magie
programme.desc: Daniel Radcliffe, Emma Watson et Rupert Grint participent à la célébration du 20e anniversaire de la sortie de Harry Potter. On raconte l'histoire fascinante de cette extraordinaire épopée à travers des séquences derrière les coulisses.

programme.title: David Holmes: le garçon qui a survécu
programme.desc: David Holmes développe un lien inextricable avec l'acteur Daniel Radcliffe alors qu'il joue son doublé dans les films "Harry Potter" mais un accident sur le tournage laisse David paralysé.

En retrouvant ses sens à l'hôpital, Maya apprend qu'elle a échappé à l'assaut, mais que Ryan est décédé de ses blessures. La chasse reprend de plus belle alors que les mystérieux tueurs qui l'ont ciblée au hasard se lancent de nouveau à ses trousses.

programme.title: Je suis toujours là
programme.desc: Rio de Janeiro, 1971, sous la dictature militaire. La grande maison des Paiva, près de la plage, est un havre de vie, de paroles partagées, de jeux, de rencontres. Jusqu'au jour où des hommes du régime viennent arrêter Rubens, le père de famille, qui disparaît sans laisser de traces. Sa femme Eunice et ses cinq enfants mèneront alors un combat acharné pour la recherche de la vérité.

programme.title: Jamais plus
programme.desc: Lily décide de se lancer dans l'aventure de l'entrepreneuriat en ouvrant une boutique de fleurs atypique alors qu'elle rencontre Ryle, un homme très séduisant, qui a tout pour plaire et dont elle tombe rapidement amoureuse. C'est sans compter sur le retour dans sa vie de son premier amour de jeunesse.

programme.title: Iris et les hommes
programme.desc: Un mari formidable, deux filles parfaites, un cabinet dentaire florissant : tout va bien pour Iris, sauf qu'elle ne parvient pas à se souvenir de la dernière fois qu'elle a fait l'amour.

programme.title: Queer
programme.desc: En 1950, William Lee, expatrié américain à Mexico, passe ses journées presque entièrement seul, à l'exception de quelques contacts avec d'autres membres de la petite communauté américaine. Sa rencontre avec Eugene Allerton, un ancien soldat expatrié nouvellement arrivé dans la ville, lui montre, pour la première fois, qu'il est peut-être enfin possible d'établir une connexion intime avec quelqu'un.

programme.title: Oh, Hi!

Iris raconte ses expériences intimes passées et Isaac s'ouvre sur ses souvenirs d'enfance. En forçant la serrure d'un placard, Iris trouve le matériel de soumission sexuelle du propriétaire. programme.title: Les secrets de l'amour
programme.desc: Dans le bureau de Daniel, Billy rencontre Jason et apprend par la même occasion qu'il est son frère; Déborah demande des explications à Angela sur le document mentionnant son adoption.

programme.title: Les secrets de l'amour
programme.desc: Rebecca surprend Melissa et Daniel en pleins ébats amoureux et décide de mettre un terme à leur relation; Kimberley trouve un accord avec Greg et Brian, qui prennent contact avec Snake Rasta pour obtenir une arme à feu.

programme.title: Juliette dans son bain
programme.desc: Ronny Kandiotis, milliardaire et amoureux des arts, est l'invité d'un grand musée, à l'occasion d'un don qu'il fait à la France de deux tableaux. Le soir même, sa fille Lara est enlevée par une mystérieuse organisation.

programme.title: Version française
programme.desc: En Dordogne, visite du musée du château de Vayres. Depuis près de cinquante ans, Alain Baraton veille sur les jardins du château de Versailles. Le styliste Demna Gvasalia tire sa révérence après une décennie passée chez Balenciaga.

programme.title: Les hôtels historiques de Suisse
programme.desc: Perdu dans les montagnes au-dessus de Davos, le Schatzalp est un ancien sanatorium de luxe transformé en hôtel; plus à l'ouest, dans l'Oberland bernois, le Bellevue des Alpes se dresse dans un décor unique, face au légendaire sommet de l'Eiger.

programme.title: Territoires de France
programme.desc: Découvrir les trésors des régions françaises et les personnes qui les font vivre.

programme.title: À bon entendeur
programme.desc: On sonde les aspects les plus divers du quotidien des ménages : teste les produits, compare les prix, traque les fraudes, met en garde les consommateurs et interpelle les fabricants.

programme.title: 39-45 en sol canadien
programme.desc: La Seconde Guerre mondiale commence; Claude découvre le déroulement du début des hostilités; de jeunes hommes décident de se porter volontaires, dont Évariste Lagacé, l'oncle de Claude; ils iront combattre les nazis.

programme.title: Au pays du bonheur
programme.desc: Marc-André part à la découverte des Pays-Bas; ici, on prend soin des ainés et on développe l'autonomie des adolescents; le vélo n'est pas seulement un moyen de transport, c'est un mode de vie ancré dans le quotidien des Néerlandais.

programme.title: Objectif monde l'hebdo
programme.desc: L'âge est la première cause de discrimination au travail ; en France, 35% des 60-64 ans sont en activité contre 61% en Allemagne ; à Bruxelles, on estime qu'environ 25% du total des chercheurs d'emploi ont plus de 50 ans ; au quotidien, le tout-numérique laisse aussi de nombreux seniors sur le bord de la route ; cette réalité, encore largement invisibilisée, porte un nom : l'âgisme.

programme.title: Mauvais garçons: à la vie, à la mort
programme.desc: Lorsque leur défunt capitaine de police est lié aux cartels de la drogue, Mike Lowrey et Marcus Burnett, deux policiers sages de Miami, se lancent dans une mission dangereuse pour blanchir son nom.

programme.title: TVA Nouvelles
programme.desc: On présente l'actualité de dernière heure en temps réel, les nouvelles régionales, internationales et économiques, et plus encore. En provenance de Montréal pour les stations des marchés de l'ouest du Québec (Gatineau, Ottawa, Sherbrooke, Trois-Rivières et Rouyn-Noranda) et de Québec pour les stations de l'est du Québec (Rimouski, Rivière-du-Loup, Carleton sur Mer et Saguenay). On couvre toute l'actualité québécoise.

programme.title: Tireur d'élite
programme.desc: Un tireur d'élite des Marines, Bob Lee Swagger, quitte l'armée après une mission qui a mal tourné et disparaît sans laisser de traces. Swagger reprend du service quand des autorités gouvernementales le persuadent d'agir contre un complot contre le président des États-Unis. programme.title: E Karga
programme.desc:
Gu Chuan sufrió un accidente automovilístico tras graduarse de la universidad. Debido a que su corazón resultó dañado, se implantó un corazón artificial. Aunque logró sobrevivir, su vida cambió para siempre. No puede participar en actividades vigorosas, no puede sentir alegría y tristeza y ya no puede vivir como una persona normal. Gu Chuan, que solía ser alegre y brillante, se cerró a medida que gradualmente perdía toda la confianza.
Diez años después, Gu Chuan y su amigo Xu Cheng Ran cofundaron el estudio arquitectónico de Chuan. Siempre que Gu Chuan reúne el coraje para superar su situación, falla cada vez hasta que conoce a Jiang Xiao Yu. Jiang Xiao Yu perdió a sus padres a una edad temprana, pero sus desgracias nunca la derrotaron. Cuando se convierten en jefe y empleada, Gu Chuan comienza a ver su pasión perdida en Jiang Xiao Yu y gradualmente encuentra su propio camino mientras la ayuda a perseguir sus sueños. ★ 7.0/10

programme.title: Los sustitutos
programme.desc: En el futuro, los humanos viven a través de robots que se controlan desde sus casas. Estos son réplicas mejoradas de ellos mismos, por lo que cuando varios de los androides aparecen asesinados, dos policías comienzan a tener problemas para diferenciar a las personas reales de los sustitutos. Jonathan Mostow (''Terminator 3''. La rebelión de las máquinas) dirige este thriller de ciencia ficción. Esta vez se sirve de la adaptación de un cómic que aporta la inquietante idea central. Aprovechando esta base, el filme critica prácticas como el sedentarismo, la creciente dependencia de la tecnología o el abuso de las redes sociales. A partir de aquí, Mostow usa un holgado presupuesto de más de 60 millones de euros para incluir secuencias de acción trepidante. La aparición del carismático Bruce Willis -ya habituado a estas propuestas- sirve de gancho para las masas. A pesar de todo, la cinta no logró recaudar en Estados Unidos ni la mitad de lo que costó. Su aceptación en el resto del mundo -en España atrajo a casi 700.000 espectadores- libró a ''Los sustitutos'' de convertirse en un fracaso comercial.

programme.title: Assassin's Creed
programme.desc: Callum Lynch explora los recuerdos de su antecesor Aguilar de Nerja y adquiere las habilidades de un maestro asesino, antes de enfrentarse a la sociedad secreta de los templarios. Justin Kurzel adapta a la gran pantalla el conocido videojuego ''Assassin's Creed'', cuya primera versión fue publicado en 2007 y trasladaba a los jugadores al corazón de las cruzadas. Aquí, el director vuelve a dar el protagonismo -tal y como hizo en ''Macbeth''- a Michael Fassbender. El popular actor se pone en la piel de un personaje que no existe en el mundo virtual, Cal Lynch, descendiente de varios linajes de los habilidosos 'assassins', una hermandad en pie de guerra contra los templarios. Cabe destacar que Fassbender no había jugado a ninguna de las nueve entregas del videojuego hasta que empezó el rodaje del filme. Sin embargo, se implicó en el proyecto porque quería hacer una película que tuviera una estrecha relación con la ciencia y, al mismo tiempo, pensó que el conflicto entre la orden de los templarios y los 'assassins' era intrigante. La película fue rodada, en parte, en España y cuenta con rostros conocidos del cine español como Carlos Bardem, Javier Gutiérrez o Hovik Keuchkerian.

programme.title: Atrapado por su pasado
programme.desc: Carlito Brigante, un puertorriqueño que acaba de salir de la cárcel, se hace la firme promesa de no volver a meterse en el mundo del tráfico de drogas y de empezar una nueva vida.

programme.title: Asesinos
programme.desc: Robert Rath trabajaba como agente secreto durante la Guerra Fría. Tras el hundimiento de la Unión Soviética, ahora se emplea por su cuenta al servicio del mundo de los negocios. Miguel Bain es un mercenario que todavía cree que las habilidades asesinas le pueden convertir en una estrella ascendente y sueña con ser el sucesor de Rath. ''Asesinos'' es un filme de acción crepuscular protagonizado por dos homicidas antitéticos enfrentados por sus diferentes maneras de ver el mundo. Se trata de una de las películas menos conseguidas de Richard Donner, a pesar de tener un punto de partida interesante. Y es que el guion original fue escrito por los hermanos Wachowski, los cuales posteriormente dirigirían la trilogía de culto ''The Matrix''. Pero durante el rodaje, los productores contrataron a Brian Helgeland (''L.A. Confidential'') para reescribir el texto. Los cambios no gustaron nada a los hermanos, que pidieron que les sacaran de los créditos, algo que no consiguieron. El resultado fue una cinta que no tuvo ni la valoración crítica ni la respuesta comercial esperada. Sin embargo, fue una de las primeras películas importantes que protagonizó el español Antonio Banderas en Hollywood.

programme.title: Cara a cara (Face off)
programme.desc: El agente federal Sean Archer consigue dar caza al peligroso terrorista internacional Castor Troy, quien, además, queda en coma durante la lucha. Pero antes de su detención, Troy había ocultado una poderosa bomba en algún lugar de Los Ángeles. Ahora, la única manera de conseguir saber dónde está el artefacto es que Archer se someta a un increíble proceso científico mediante el cual se le implantará la cara de Troy. Espectacularidad visual, mezcla de géneros y mutuas parodias entre John Travolta y Nicolas Cage hicieron de ''Cara a cara'' - la tercera película yanqui del maestro asiático John Woo- la primera supertaquillera. Tras ''Blanco humano'' y ''Alarma nuclear'', el realizador de Hong Kong continuó aquí con su habitual despliegue de violencia e increíbles secuencias de acción para explicar esta historia con ribetes de ciencia ficción. Vale la pena ver a Travolta y a Cage intercambiando sus personajes e imitando sus acentos, gestos, miradas y movimientos. Curiosamente, en un primer momento, Cage rechazó el papel al saber que debía interpretar al villano de la función. Pero al leer el guion y comprobar que durante la mayor parte del metraje sería el héroe, cambió de opinión.

But when beauty queen Abbie takes these findings to the police, they are unable to do anything about it, and the Catfish of Kilmarnock remains free to target more and more victims. Abbie can’t walk away, and steps up her investigation over months that turn into years. programme.title: Los sustitutos
programme.desc: En el futuro, los humanos viven a través de robots que se controlan desde sus casas. Estos son réplicas mejoradas de ellos mismos, por lo que cuando varios de los androides aparecen asesinados, dos policías comienzan a tener problemas para diferenciar a las personas reales de los sustitutos. Jonathan Mostow (''Terminator 3''. La rebelión de las máquinas) dirige este thriller de ciencia ficción. Esta vez se sirve de la adaptación de un cómic que aporta la inquietante idea central. Aprovechando esta base, el filme critica prácticas como el sedentarismo, la creciente dependencia de la tecnología o el abuso de las redes sociales. A partir de aquí, Mostow usa un holgado presupuesto de más de 60 millones de euros para incluir secuencias de acción trepidante. La aparición del carismático Bruce Willis -ya habituado a estas propuestas- sirve de gancho para las masas. A pesar de todo, la cinta no logró recaudar en Estados Unidos ni la mitad de lo que costó. Su aceptación en el resto del mundo -en España atrajo a casi 700.000 espectadores- libró a ''Los sustitutos'' de convertirse en un fracaso comercial.

programme.title: Assassin's Creed
programme.desc: Callum Lynch explora los recuerdos de su antecesor Aguilar de Nerja y adquiere las habilidades de un maestro asesino, antes de enfrentarse a la sociedad secreta de los templarios. Justin Kurzel adapta a la gran pantalla el conocido videojuego ''Assassin's Creed'', cuya primera versión fue publicado en 2007 y trasladaba a los jugadores al corazón de las cruzadas. Aquí, el director vuelve a dar el protagonismo -tal y como hizo en ''Macbeth''- a Michael Fassbender. El popular actor se pone en la piel de un personaje que no existe en el mundo virtual, Cal Lynch, descendiente de varios linajes de los habilidosos 'assassins', una hermandad en pie de guerra contra los templarios. Cabe destacar que Fassbender no había jugado a ninguna de las nueve entregas del videojuego hasta que empezó el rodaje del filme. Sin embargo, se implicó en el proyecto porque quería hacer una película que tuviera una estrecha relación con la ciencia y, al mismo tiempo, pensó que el conflicto entre la orden de los templarios y los 'assassins' era intrigante. La película fue rodada, en parte, en España y cuenta con rostros conocidos del cine español como Carlos Bardem, Javier Gutiérrez o Hovik Keuchkerian.

programme.title: Atrapado por su pasado
programme.desc: Carlito Brigante, un puertorriqueño que acaba de salir de la cárcel, se hace la firme promesa de no volver a meterse en el mundo del tráfico de drogas y de empezar una nueva vida.

programme.title: El especialista
programme.desc: Un experto en explosivos, antiguo miembro de la CIA, recibe una oferta de trabajo de una hermosa y misteriosa mujer. La dama pretende vengarse de un grupo de mafiosos que asesinaron a sus padres cuando ella era una niña. El hombre en cuestión no quiere involucrarse en el caso, pero la aparición de un antiguo colega le hará cambiar de opinión. Con un reparto espectacular pero unos efectos especiales poco cuidados, este filme de acción de Luis Llosa fue mal valorado por la crítica, que lo llegó a tildar de serie B. La película combina las expectativas sugeridas por el protagonismo de Sylvester Stallone y Sharon Stone, es decir: violencia y erotismo. Siguiendo la línea de thrillers que inició con ''Instinto Básico'' y ''Acosada'', la actriz comparte aquí varias escenas de alto voltaje con su musculosa pareja, cuya figura cinematográfica comenzaba ya a dar muestras de cansancio. Completan el lujoso reparto los actores James Woods y Rod Steiger, en una película que a veces recuerda la estética de los filmes de acción de los 70.

programme.title: Muerte bajo cero
programme.desc: La Oficina Nacional de Investigación se hace cargo de la investigación. Hautalehto y otros miembros de la policía de Porvoo son sospechosos de proteger a uno de los suyos.

programme.title: Muerte bajo cero
programme.desc: Los medios de comunicación presionan y el alto mando policial espera resultados. Hautalehto lleva a cabo sus propias investigaciones en secreto.

programme.title: Muerte bajo cero
programme.desc: La Oficina Nacional de Investigación y Hautalehto unen sus fuerzas para llegar al fondo del asunto. Hautalehto subestima la furiosa venganza del maníaco asesino.

programme.title: Muerte bajo cero
programme.desc: Antti Hautalehto y sus colegas están en la fiesta del 60 cumpleaños de su jefe cuando les envían a investigar la muerte del psiquiatra Oskari Broman en un jacuzzi.

programme.title: Muerte bajo cero
programme.desc: En el bosque, el cuerpo envuelto en sudarios es extraído de la tumba, pero bajo las telas no hay un cadáver real, sino un maniquí que representa al inspector Antti Hautalehto.

programme.title: Chopper
programme.desc: La historia de un hombre que declaró haber asesinado a diecinueve personas y salió sin cargo de todos los casos. Con bajo presupuesto y sin demasiadas pretensiones, ''Chopper'' plantea un tema bastante polémico, como es el caso de un asesino en serie que quedó impune de todos los cargos. De hecho, el director Andrew Dominik debuta tras las cámaras, a partir de una adaptación de las propias memorias del asesino. Sin embargo, y pese a la buena acogida de la crítica, esta película australiana no obtuvo demasiado éxito en taquilla.

programme.title: Muerte en Angulema
programme.desc: La capitana Marie Jourdan invita a su amigo, el comandante Paul Danceny, y a su padre a celebrar su 30º aniversario en el restaurante que acaba de abrir su esposo Pierre. La fiesta es interrumpida.

programme.title: Asesinato en Toulouse

programme.title: Tras la pista del asesino
programme.desc: Dos agentes del FBI se unen al departamento de policía de Texas para investigar una red de tráfico sexual, sin saber que sus caminos se cruzarán con el peor asesino en serie de la historia del estado.

programme.title: El caso Miranda
programme.desc: En 1963 Patricia Weir es secuestrada y brutalmente violada. En su lucha por encarcelar a su agresor el sistema legal estadounidense destruye su vida al desencadenar una ley que transforma la Nación.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Dos grandes pilotos de Fórmula 1, el británico James Hunt y el austriaco Niki Lauda, tienen una gran rivalidad en 1976, año en el que Lauda sufrió un gravísimo accidente que casi le costó la vida. Cinta ambientada en los años 70, glamurosa edad de oro de la Fórmula 1, que narra la gran rivalidad personal y deportiva que mantuvieron los pilotos James Hunt y Niki Lauda durante sus carreras. El cineasta estadounidense Ron Howard (''El código Da Vinci'', ''Cinderella Man'') dirige esta película que cuenta con un guion firmado por Peter Morgan, nominado a los premios Oscar por sus trabajos en ''Frost/Nixon'' y ''The Queen (La Reina)''. Chris Hemsworth (''Thor'', ''Los Vengadores'') y el catalán Daniel Brühl (''Good Bye Lenin!'', ''Malditos bastardos'') se ponen en la piel de los míticos pilotos, consiguiendo un trabajo creíble que le valió a Brühl la nominación al Globo de Oro como mejor actor secundario. Olivia Wilde (''TRON: Legacy'', ''House''), Natalie Dorner (''Juego de Tronos'') y Alexandra Maria Lara (''Control'') ponen el toque femenino en una película marcada por la testosterona. Bien recibida por la crítica, el público también le dio el beneplácito, ya que cosechó buenos resultados en taquilla.

programme.desc: When rancher Frank Tanner (Jon Cypher) hoodwinks local lawman Bob Valdez (Burt Lancaster) into shooting an innocent man, Valdez is remorseful and tries to take up a collection for the widow. Tanner won't hear of it, however, and punishes Valdez by driving him into the desert with a cross strapped to his back. Valdez is freed by one of Tanner's henchmen (Richard Jordan) and, after convalescing, begins waging a one-man war against Tanner, picking off his men with his trusty Sharps rifle.

programme.title: Trooper Hook
programme.desc: Wanted for killing a squadron of soldiers, Apache Chief Nanchez (Rudolfo Acosta) is finally captured by Sgt. Clovis Hook (Joel McCrea), who discovers among Nanchez's prisoners Cora Sutliff (Barbara Stanwyck), who had been missing for several years. Sutliff has not only fully integrated into the Apache way of life, she also has a son with Nanchez. Now Hook wants to transport her back to her old way of life, but Nanchez isn't willing to let his son be taken from him.

programme.title: Fury at Showdown
programme.desc: Reformed ex-convict Brock Mitchell (John Derek) completes a prison sentence for shooting a man in a desperate act of self-defense and travels to the ranch run by his brother, Tracy (Nick Adams). Now an outcast in his own hometown, Brock throws himself into raising animals and working the land. As the newly reconciled Mitchells make up for lost time, vicious gunslinger Miley Sutton (John Smith) finds himself on the payroll of the crooked brother of the man Brock killed.

programme.title: Adios Sabata
programme.desc: Gunslinger Sabata (Yul Brynner) allies himself with a group of wily Mexican revolutionaries scheming to overthrow Emperor Maximilian and expel the occupying Austrians from their homeland. Part of their plan involves stealing a shipment of gold and using it to purchase artillery. It won't be easy, however, as the gold is under the protection of the corrupt and sadistic Col. Skimmel (Gerard Herter). As Sabata pulls off the daring heist, he must take on dozens of enraged Austrian forces.

programme.title: Frontier Uprising
programme.desc: A wagon train heads for California unaware that local Indians have sided with Mexico against the United States.

programme.title: Man With the Gun
programme.desc: Sheridan City is out of control. The citizens are corrupt, the saloon is an immoral indulgence, and gunmen and greedy opportunists come and go as they please. With the town's lawman (Henry Hull) incapable of maintaining order, the town council brings in a hired gun, Clint Tollinger (Robert Mitchum), who has business of his own with the saloon madame (Jan Sterling). Tollinger sets about proving his reputation as a "town tamer" through his signature approach: eradicating violence with violence.

programme.title: Gun the Man Down
programme.desc: An outlaw is left by his cohorts and girlfriend to be captured after he is wounded during a heist. When he is released from prison, he tracks his old crew to a run-down town and plays a game of cat and mouse with them.

programme.title: The Broken Star
programme.desc: Deputy Marshal Frank Smeed (Howard Duff) guns down an innocent Mexican who was about to deliver a huge sum of gold to a land tycoon, then makes off with the loot and covers his tracks by claiming that the man he shot was a dangerous criminal. Deputy Marshal Bill Gantry (Bill Williams) is charged with investigating the matter to ensure that his close friend Smeed was in the right. When he gets too close to discovering the truth, the crooked deputy tries to make Gantry his next victim.

programme.title: Cattle Annie and Little Britches
programme.desc: Two teenage girls rally what's left of the Doolin-Dalton outlaw gang after Doolin is caught.

programme.title: Day of the Outlaw
programme.desc: In the quiet frontier town of Bitters, Wyo., a dispute between cattleman Blaise Starrett and farmer Hal Crane is about to boil over into a bloody feud. But the fighting takes a back seat to a new threat when a rogue cavalry captain, Jack Bruhn, rides into town with his band of thugs. Now, with the citizens of Bitters held hostage by Bruhn and his men, Starrett must somehow rescue his town and restore his broken reputation.

programme.title: Drango
programme.desc: With the Civil War still a fresh memory, Maj. Clint Drango (Jeff Chandler) of the Union Army must restore order to Kennesaw Pass, Georgia. However, even with the trusty Capt. Marc Banning (John Lupton) along, he faces a distrustful town, as well as former Confederates led by the manipulative Clay Allen (Ronald Howard). A high-stakes battle of wills ensues as Drango, who hides a dark secret related to the town, must win the people's support to prevent the Union Army from intervening.

programme.title: Comanche
programme.desc: Renegade Comanche leader Black Cloud (Henry Brandon) attacks a Mexican village and kidnaps the beautiful Margarita Alvarez (Linda Cristal). Fleeing to the United States, they come across a band of scalp hunters and are prevented from massacring them by the Comanche chief of the Antelope tribe, Quanah (Kent Smith). Despite the efforts of frontier scout Jim Read (Dana Andrews), turmoil erupts between the whites and the rebel Comanche, and Quanah and Read struggle to restore peace.

programme.title: Young Billy Young
programme.desc: Fleeing the scene of a gruesome gunfight in Mexico, Billy Young (Robert Walker) arrives in the small town of Lordsburg, where he is promptly deputized by local sheriff Ben Kane (Robert Mitchum). Kane takes the troubled young man under his wing, hoping to reform his lawless ways. As the bond between the two men grows stronger, Kane recruits Young for a particularly personal assignment: to help bring to justice Frank Boone (John Anderson), a vicious outlaw responsible for the death of his son.

programme.title: Chopper
programme.desc: La historia de un hombre que declaró haber asesinado a diecinueve personas y salió sin cargo de todos los casos. Con bajo presupuesto y sin demasiadas pretensiones, ''Chopper'' plantea un tema bastante polémico, como es el caso de un asesino en serie que quedó impune de todos los cargos. De hecho, el director Andrew Dominik debuta tras las cámaras, a partir de una adaptación de las propias memorias del asesino. Sin embargo, y pese a la buena acogida de la crítica, esta película australiana no obtuvo demasiado éxito en taquilla.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Dos grandes pilotos de Fórmula 1, el británico James Hunt y el austriaco Niki Lauda, tienen una gran rivalidad en 1976, año en el que Lauda sufrió un gravísimo accidente que casi le costó la vida. Cinta ambientada en los años 70, glamurosa edad de oro de la Fórmula 1, que narra la gran rivalidad personal y deportiva que mantuvieron los pilotos James Hunt y Niki Lauda durante sus carreras. El cineasta estadounidense Ron Howard (''El código Da Vinci'', ''Cinderella Man'') dirige esta película que cuenta con un guion firmado por Peter Morgan, nominado a los premios Oscar por sus trabajos en ''Frost/Nixon'' y ''The Queen (La Reina)''. Chris Hemsworth (''Thor'', ''Los Vengadores'') y el catalán Daniel Brühl (''Good Bye Lenin!'', ''Malditos bastardos'') se ponen en la piel de los míticos pilotos, consiguiendo un trabajo creíble que le valió a Brühl la nominación al Globo de Oro como mejor actor secundario. Olivia Wilde (''TRON: Legacy'', ''House''), Natalie Dorner (''Juego de Tronos'') y Alexandra Maria Lara (''Control'') ponen el toque femenino en una película marcada por la testosterona. Bien recibida por la crítica, el público también le dio el beneplácito, ya que cosechó buenos resultados en taquilla.

programme.title: Hermanos y Enemigos (Petrovic y Divac)
programme.desc: Drazen Petrovic, de Croacia, y Vlade Divac, de Serbia, fueron dos jugadores clave en la selección de básquet yugoslava y gracias a su talento lograron triunfar en la NBA. Pero la amistad que les unió se vio afectada por el inicio de la guerra de los Balcanes (1991), cuando Croacia declaró su independencia. Los dos amigos no volvieron a dirigirse la palabra y Petrovic murió en un accidente de coche antes de que pudieran reconciliarse.Este documental forma parte de la serie ''30 for 30'' de la ESPN (Entertainment and Sports Programming Network) en motivo de su 30 aniversario en 2009. En esta colección se repasa la historia del deporte estadounidense a través de las anécdotas y curiosidades más destacables de las últimas tres décadas. La cadena de televisión, dedicada exclusivamente al ámbito deportivo, encargó cada uno de los documentales a distintos directores de Hollywood como Bill Couturié (''Cartas des de Vietnam''), Reggie Rock Bythewood (''Sombras de Nueva York'') y el director de este filme Michael Tolajian (''Hermanos y Enemigos (Petrovic y Divac)''), entre otros. El resultado de este ambicioso y arriesgado proyecto fue todo un éxito. When a British expedition enters the jungle, Tarzan encounters the beautiful Jane (Minnie Driver) and recognizes that, like her, he's human. Falling in love with Jane, Tarzan is torn between embracing civilization and staying with his gorilla family, which becomes threatened by the ruthless hunter Clayton (Brian Blessed).

programme.desc: Remy (Patton Oswalt), a resident of Paris, appreciates good food and has quite a sophisticated palate. He would love to become a chef so he can create and enjoy culinary masterpieces to his heart's delight. The only problem is, Remy is a rat. When he winds up in the sewer beneath one of Paris' finest restaurants, the rodent gourmet finds himself ideally placed to realize his dream.

programme.title: Zootopia
programme.desc: From the largest elephant to the smallest shrew, the city of Zootopia is a mammal metropolis where various animals live and thrive. When Judy Hopps (Ginnifer Goodwin) becomes the first rabbit to join the police force, she quickly learns how tough it is to enforce the law. Determined to prove herself, Judy jumps at the opportunity to solve a mysterious case. Unfortunately, that means working with Nick Wilde (Jason Bateman), a wily fox who makes her job even harder.

programme.title: Brother Bear
programme.desc: Kenai is a young Indian brave with a particular distaste for bears. When his brother Sitka is killed by one, Kenai in turn kills the bear, only to be magically transformed into one himself. To make matters worse, his other brother Denahi vows to kill the bear Kenai has become. Kenai's only hope is a magical mountain where he believes he can be changed back to a human, and he enlists a real bear cub, Koda, to get him there.

programme.title: El Mister
programme.desc: Después de ser expulsado de la NCAA por lanzarle una silla al árbitro, Marvyn Korn, un entrenador de baloncesto masculino, empieza a trabajar en Westbrook, un elitista colegio de chicas y su única opción para salvar lo que queda de su carrera y reputación. Al principio, Marvyn enfoca su nuevo empleo como un alto en el camino de su vuelta al baloncesto universitario. Además, las chicas no se toman en serio el equipo. El impasible Marvyn pronto descubre que las adolescentes son seres humanos complejos, que no solo viven de mano dura y días de entrenamiento doble, sino que necesitan a alguien que las oriente y se preocupe por ellas. Mientras aprende a forjar vínculos con sus jugadoras y a ser más empático, el entrenador se empieza a convertir en la persona que siempre ha querido ser y en el padre que nunca tuvo. Las chicas, por su parte, aprenden a tomarse más en serio a sí mismas, a dar la calidad que Marvyn exige y a encontrar su lugar, tanto dentro como fuera de la cancha. ★ 7.9/10

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football : Part One: 1869-1932
programme.desc: In the aftermath of the Civil War, America's South is looking to put the past behind it, and finds one path in a growing cultural passion of the North - football. In December 1932, the Southeastern Conference is officially formed.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football : Part Two: 1933-1959
programme.desc: Multiple SEC schools claim national titles from the 1930s through the '50s, including LSU with star running back Billy Cannon in 1958, prior to Cannon's epic game-winning punt return against powerhouse Ole Miss a year later.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football : Part Three: 1960-1970
programme.desc: In the 1960s, as Georgia Tech leaves the conference and the Civil Rights Movement becomes embedded in the history and image of the region, Bear Bryant, hired in 1958, becomes the face of Alabama - and SEC football.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football : Part Four: 1969-1979
programme.desc: As a new decade dawns, quarterbacks Archie Manning, Bert Jones and Condredge Holloway build memorable legacies. Bear Bryant begins a new run of dominance at Alabama, and the rise of television sports transforms the SEC.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football : Part Five: 1980-1989
programme.desc: The 1980s begin with Herschel Walker leading Georgia to a national title as a freshman. After Bear Bryant retires in 1982 and passes away four weeks later, control of the SEC is eventually transferred to Pat Dye and Bo Jackson at Auburn.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football : Part Six: 1990-1999
programme.desc: The 1990s bring change, with expansion and the sport's first-ever conference championship game. Florida's Steve Spurrier fashions an era of high-octane offense, and his Gators form a rivalry with Tennessee and QB Peyton Manning.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football : Part Seven: 2000-2009
programme.desc: Nick Saban comes to LSU in 2000 and eventually wins the Tigers' first national championship since 1958 - a feat matched by Les Miles. At Florida, Tim Tebow becomes a cult hero and wins two national titles with Urban Meyer's Gators.

programme.title: Saturdays In the South: A History of SEC Football : Part Eight: 2010-Present
programme.desc: The SEC has a run of seven straight national titles, and nine in 12 years. Expansion in 2012 gives the conference 14 schools. Meanwhile, Nick Saban arguably becomes the greatest coach in the history of college football.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S11 E07 Cantina Culture and the Morning After? Cantinas have historically been bars where men gather to drink and sing about their broken hearts. Historian David Canales takes Pati to historic locations. Then she tries the best tacos in town.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S11 E08 Texas BBQ in the Orange Belt Pati visits BBQ champion Luis Rivas to taste his Mexican take on Texas-style BBQ, and he hosts a traditional carne asada at his family's orange grove. Then Pati learns how Glorias candies are made.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S11 E09 A Day With Hugo Chef Hugo Guajardo researches the best of Nuevo León's ingredients. He and Pati visit a family-owned restaurant that has perfected the art of drying meat. Then, she tries his famed charred chicken.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S11 E10 Top Chefs and Ancient Cliffs Pati's climber friends take her on an adventure to the Sierra Madre mountains, followed by a quick elote snack. Later, Pati connects with four top chefs for a carne asada with a mountain backdrop.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E01 The Nectar of the Mayan Gods Pati is in the magic town of Maní to learn about something sacred to the Mayans - bees and honey. A group of women who protect the endangered Melipona, a stingless bee native to Yucatán, invites her to join in a Mayan energy cleansing ritual.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E02 Guayabera World In Tekit, the capital of the Guayabera, Pati encounters a tale of sons going against their father's wishes to follow their own path. Pati meets a farmer's son who went against his father to build a family business making the iconic Guayabera shirts.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E03 The Best Tacos In Mérida Pati explores the streets of Yucatán's capital, Mérida. She tries the best tacos in Mérida at Wayan'e. The aroma of freshly made cookies lures her to Dondé Fabric, where their globitos and bizcochitos are an important part of Mérida's mornings.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E04 An Underground Pit of Cochinita Pibil Pati visits Chef Wilson Alonzo in his hometown of Halachó to prepare a traditional Cochinita Pibil in an underground pit. Pati helps Wilson prepare the achiote marinade, along with his grandmother who taught him traditional cooking.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E05 The Art of the Egg Pati arrives in Motul, a town in the history books for Yucatán's once thriving henequén industry and for the egg dish Huevos Motuleños. Pati meets Doña Evelia, who put Motul back on the map with her world-famous recipe.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E06 Yucatán Meats Temozón is the birthplace of Yucatán's signature smoked meat Carne Ahumada and everyone in town claims to have a relative who invented it. Pati strolls around town to try different versions of Carne Ahumada.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E07 The Famous Pastes of Spices Pati returns to Mérida to meet sisters, Delia and Maria Elide, who love to cook and laugh and are famous for recados - pastes of spices and aromatic herbs that season Yucatecan foods. In Uxmal, she learns about ingredients that make recados unique.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E08 Mayan Gateway To The Underworld No trip to Yucatán is complete without seeing a beautiful cenote, natural freshwater pools in caves. To learn more about Mayan communities, Pati visits Cenote Xocempich with lawyer Zoila Cen, who has dedicated her career to helping Mayan people.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E09 Yucatán's Most Unique Salts An ingredient Pati constantly uses is salt and Yucatán has one of the most unique salts. The Las Coloradas salt, which means blush red, gets its distinctive color from red algae. Felipe Perez takes Pati to the pink lakes where the salt is produced.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table
programme.desc: S12 E10 A Mayan League of their Own In Yaxunah, Pati discovers Yucatán's league of their own. She joins the Amazonas, a softball team of indigenous women, for their morning practice. As they built a name for themselves, they overcame the mindset that women belong in the kitchen.

programme.desc: S01 E06 Tuscan Farmhouse Classics Jamie is taking spaghetti bolognese to the next level and re-creating a mind-blowing Jewish-Italian recipe. There's also beef stew with pappardelle.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy

programme.desc: La rápida trayectoria exitosa del Dr. Hank Lawson se ve obstruida al ser culpado de la muerte de un administrador del hospital y es colocado en la lista negra de la comunidad médica; su vida cambia un fin de semana en los Hamptons, cuando ayuda a un invitado en una fiesta que necesitaba atención médica y su hermano menor Evan lo anima para iniciar su práctica privada en esa localidad, pero ser el doctor de los ricos y famosos no es exactamente lo que ambicionaba en su vida profesional.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La doctora Ana María Polo interviene en batallas legales que afectan a los latinos. Como en una corte, las partes presentan testigos y evidencias para que ella emita su decisión. Además, expertos contribuyen con sus conocimientos.
